# K-Downloader

Status: Draft for discussion. No application implementation has started.

## Goal

Accept one KHInsider album URL or a pasted list of album URLs, identify their
audio tracks, and download each album into its own local folder with clear
progress and recoverable failures.

Example input:
https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack

"Entire album" initially means one audio file per track, preferring lossless
when available. Each download offers the formats actually available for that
album, with per-track availability shown before starting.

## Confirmed Requirements

Confirmed on 2026-10-12:

- The application is named K-Downloader.
- A desktop GUI is the primary interface, with a scriptable CLI option too.
- Support a pasted list of album URLs in the initial release, not just one album.
- Individual track-page downloads require no login, as confirmed by the user.
  Separate audio files in each album folder are sufficient; the site's bulk
  archive is not a required output.
- Plan an optional site-login capability for the official bulk-download feature,
  available only when the account has the required standing.
- The GUI offers an opt-in "Remember me" checkbox using secure Linux storage,
  with logout and removal of saved authentication.
- Default output is `~/Music/K-Downloader`, with an alternate destination
  selectable by the user. Use numbered track filenames and save cover artwork
  when available.
- Prefer lossless downloads when available; allow format selection for each
  download based on the formats discovered on the site.
- Automatically fall back to available lossy audio when lossless is unavailable,
  showing the fallback before downloading. Offer a lossless-only option.
- In lossless-only mode, block the run if any track lacks lossless audio unless
  the user explicitly chooses to skip those tracks. Report that album as incomplete.
- Linux is the only required platform for the init

_**User (2026-10-12 13:34:03Z)**_

I do not wish to go down a development effort if we are unsure if the chosen client can retrieve the album’s track links and resolve a public track’s audio URL without login or bypassing access controls. How do we verify?

---

_**Agent (copilot/auto)**_

Use a small, disposable probe with the actual client library planned for the app. That answers the key question before we invest in the GUI or downloader; a successful browser visit alone wouldn’t prove the client can do it.

1. Check the site’s applicable terms and request limits. Keep the test logged out, use a truthful user-agent, and make only the requests needed for one album and one track.
2. With the candidate client, request the album page and record the status, final URL, and response type. Parse the page and confirm it finds all 19 advertised track links, in order, without navigation or recommendation links.
3. Request one track page and confirm the client can find its offered audio link and format from the page itself, including any relative URL or redirect.
4. Make a bounded request to that audio URL to verify it is reachable and returns an audio response. Prefer a one-byte range request; if the server ignores ranges, abort after a small byte limit rather than allowing a full track download. Don’t forward cookies or credentials to another host.
5. Compare the extracted links and format with what the site displays in an ordinary logged-out browser session, then save sanitized results so the test is reproducible.

**Pass:** the client discovers all album tracks, resolves one track’s audio URL, and gets a valid, bounded audio response without authentication or special access workarounds. **Fail:** access requires login, a CAPTCHA/challenge workaround, or other circumvention; or the client keeps receiving access-denied responses. In that case, stop and revisit feasibility rather than disguising the client or building around the restriction.

The plan already notes that plain `curl` got HTTP 403, so this test should use the intended client directly. A 403 from that test is a stop signal, not an invitation to evade the restriction.

+#!/usr/bin/env node

+import { lookup } from "node:dns/promises";
+import { isIP } from "node:net";
+import { parse } from "parse5";
+
+const DEFAULT_ALBUM_URL =
+  "https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack";
+const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
+const USER_AGENT = `K-Downloader-feasibility-probe/0.1${process.env.K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT ? ` (${process.env.K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT})` : ""}`;
+const PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
+const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000;
+const REDIRECT_LIMIT = 5;
+const AUDIO_FORMATS = ["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"];
+
+function usage() {
+  console.log(`Usage: node verify-khinsider-access.mjs [album-url] [options]
+
+Options:
+  --expected-tracks N   Require exactly N discovered track links
+  --probe-media         Make one bounded request to the first audio link found
+  --max-media-bytes N   Maximum response bytes read (default: 65536; max: 65536)
+  --help                Show this help
+
+Without --probe-media, the script stops after resolving an audio link on one
+track page. No login, cookies, or full audio downloads are used.`);
+}
+
+function parseArgs(args) {
+  let albumUrl = DEFAULT_ALBUM_URL;
+  let expectedTracks;
+  let probeMedia = false;
+  let maxMediaBytes = 65_536;
+  let urlSeen = false;
+
+  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
+    const arg = args[index];
+    if (arg === "--help") {
+      usage();
+      process.exit(0);
+    } else if (arg === "--probe-media") {
+      probeMedia = true;
+    } else if (arg === "--expected-tracks" || arg === "--max-media-bytes") {
+      const value = Number(args[index + 1]);
+      if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
+        throw new Error(`${arg} requires a positive integer`);
+      }
+      index += 1;
+      if (arg === "--expected-tracks") expectedTracks = value;
+      else maxMediaBytes = value;
+    } else if (arg.startsWith("-")) {
+      throw new Error(`Unknown option: ${arg}`);
+    } else if (!urlSeen) {
+      albumUrl = arg;
+      urlSeen = true;
+    } else {
+      throw new Error("Provide at most one album URL");
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (maxMediaBytes > 65_536) {
+    throw new Error("--max-media-bytes cannot exceed 65536");
+  }
+
+  const parsedAlbumUrl = new URL(albumUrl);
+  if (
+    parsedAlbumUrl.protocol !== "https:" ||
+    parsedAlbumUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
+    parsedAlbumUrl.username ||
+    parsedAlbumUrl.password ||
+    !parsedAlbumUrl.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
+  ) {
+    throw new Error(`Album URL must be an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
+  }
+
+  return { albumUrl: parsedAlbumUrl, expectedTracks, probeMedia, maxMediaBytes };
+}
+
+function nodeText(node) {
+  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
+  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(nodeText).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
+}
+
+function* walk(node) {
+  yield node;
+  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
+}
+
+function attributes(node) {
+  return Object.fromEntries((node.attrs ?? []).map(({ name, value }) => [name, value]));
+}
+
+function hrefFrom(node, baseUrl) {
+  const href = attributes(node).href;
+  if (!href) return undefined;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(href, baseUrl);
+    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
+    return url;
+  } catch {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+}
+
+function numberedRow(row) {
+  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
+  return cells.some((cell) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(nodeText(cell)));
+}
+
+function findTracks(document, albumUrl) {
+  const tracks = [];
+  const seen = new Set();
+  for (const row of walk(document)) {
+    if (row.tagName !== "tr" || !numberedRow(row)) continue;
+    const rowLinks = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
+    const candidates = rowLinks
+      .map((node) => ({ node, url: hrefFrom(node, albumUrl), title: nodeText(node) }))
+      .filter(({ url }) =>
+        url &&
+        url.hostname.toLowerCase() === SITE_HOST &&
+        url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/") &&
+        url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") !== albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") &&
+        !url.pathname.startsWith("/cp/")
+      );
+
+    const chosen = candidates.find(({ title }) => title.length > 0) ?? candidates[0];
+    if (chosen && !seen.has(chosen.url.href)) {
+      seen.add(chosen.url.href);
+      tracks.push({ title: chosen.title || `Track ${tracks.length + 1}`, url: chosen.url });
+    }
+  }
+  return tracks;
+}
+
+function findAdvertisedTrackCount(document) {
+  const text = nodeText(document);
+  const match = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
+  return match ? Number(match[1]) : undefined;
+}
+
+function audioFormat(url, label) {
+  const match = `${url.pathname} ${label}`.match(new RegExp(`\\b(${AUDIO_FORMATS.join("|")})\\b`, "i"));
+  return match?.[1]?.toUpperCase();
+}
+
+function findAudioLinks(document, pageUrl) {
+  const links = [];
+  const seen = new Set();
+  for (const node of walk(document)) {
+    let url;
+    let label;
+    if (node.tagName === "a") {
+      url = hrefFrom(node, pageUrl);
+      label = nodeText(node);
+    } else if (node.tagName === "source" || node.tagName === "audio") {
+      const attrs = attributes(node);
+      url = attrs.src ? hrefFrom({ attrs: [{ name: "href", value: attrs.src }] }, pageUrl) : undefined;
+      label = attrs.type ?? "audio source";
+    }
+    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
+    const format = audioFormat(url, label);
+    if (format || /download/i.test(label)) {
+      seen.add(url.href);
+      links.push({ url, label: label || "audio download", format });
+    }
+  }
+  return links;
+}
+
+function isPrivateAddress(address) {
+  if (address.includes(":")) {
+    const normalized = address.toLowerCase();
+    return normalized === "::1" || normalized.startsWith("fc") || normalized.startsWith("fd") || normalized.startsWith("fe80:");
+  }
+  const octets = address.split(".").map(Number);
+  return (
+    octets[0] === 0 ||
+    octets[0] === 10 ||
+    octets[0] === 127 ||
+    (octets[0] === 169 && octets[1] === 254) ||
+    (octets[0] === 172 && octets[1] >= 16 && octets[1] <= 31) ||
+    (octets[0] === 192 && octets[1] === 168) ||
+    octets[0] >= 224
+  );
+}
+
+async function validateMediaUrl(url) {
+  const hostname = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
+  if (
+    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
+    url.username ||
+    url.password ||
+    hostname === "localhost" ||
+    hostname.endsWith(".localhost") ||
+    hostname.endsWith(".local") ||
+    hostname.endsWith(".internal")
+  ) {
+    throw new Error(`Refusing non-public or non-HTTPS media URL: ${url.origin}`);
+  }
+
+  if (isIP(hostname)) {
+    if (isPrivateAddress(hostname)) throw new Error(`Refusing private media IP: ${hostname}`);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const addresses = await lookup(hostname, { all: true, verbatim: true });
+  if (addresses.length === 0 || addresses.some(({ address }) => isPrivateAddress(address))) {
+    throw new Error(`Refusing media host that resolves to a private address: ${hostname}`);
+  }
+}
+
+async function requestFollowingRedirects(initialUrl, { media = false, headers = {} } = {}) {
+  let url = new URL(initialUrl);
+  for (let redirectCount = 0; redirectCount <= REDIRECT_LIMIT; redirectCount += 1) {
+    if (media) await validateMediaUrl(url);
+    else if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST) {
+      throw new Error(`Refusing album or track redirect outside https://${SITE_HOST}`);
+    }
+
+    const response = await fetch(url, {
+      method: "GET",
+      headers: { "user-agent": USER_AGENT, ...headers },
+      redirect: "manual",
+      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS),
+    });
+    if (![301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(response.status)) return { response, url };
+
+    const location = response.headers.get("location");
+    await response.body?.cancel();
+    if (!location) throw new Error(`Redirect from ${url.origin} did not include a Location header`);
+    if (redirectCount === REDIRECT_LIMIT) throw new Error(`More than ${REDIRECT_LIMIT} redirects`);
+    url = new URL(location, url);
+  }
+  throw new Error("Redirect limit exceeded");
+}
+
+async function readLimited(response, byteLimit) {
+  if (!response.body) return { bytes: 0, truncated: false, data: Buffer.alloc(0) };
+  const reader = response.body.getReader();
+  const chunks = [];
+  let bytes = 0;
+  let truncated = false;
+  while (bytes < byteLimit) {
+    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
+    if (done) break;
+    const remaining = byteLimit - bytes;
+    const chunk = value.subarray(0, remaining);
+    chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
+    bytes += chunk.length;
+    if (chunk.length < value.length || bytes === byteLimit) {
+      truncated = true;
+      await reader.cancel();
+      break;
+    }
+  }
+  return { bytes, truncated, data: Buffer.concat(chunks) };
+}
+
+async function fetchHtml(url) {
+  const { response, url: finalUrl } = await requestFollowingRedirects(url);
+  console.log(`GET ${url.href} -> HTTP ${response.status} (${finalUrl.href})`);
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    await response.body?.cancel();
+    throw new Error(`Page request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
+  }
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "unknown";
+  if (!contentType.toLowerCase().includes("text/html")) {
+    await response.body?.cancel();
+    throw new Error(`Expected an HTML page, received ${contentType}`);
+  }
+  const result = await readLimited(response, PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES);
+  if (result.truncated) throw new Error(`HTML response exceeded ${PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES} bytes`);
+  return { document: parse(result.data.toString("utf8")), finalUrl };
+}
+
+async function probeMedia(candidate, maxBytes) {
+  console.log(`\nBounded media probe: ${candidate.url.href}`);
+  const { response, url } = await requestFollowingRedirects(candidate.url, {
+    media: true,
+    headers: { range: "bytes=0-0" },
+  });
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "unknown";
+  const contentRange = response.headers.get("content-range");
+  const responseLimit = response.status === 206 && /^bytes 0-0\//i.test(contentRange ?? "") ? 1 : maxBytes;
+  const result = await readLimited(response, responseLimit);
+  console.log(`GET with Range: bytes=0-0 -> HTTP ${response.status} (${url.href})`);
+  console.log(`Content-Type: ${contentType}; Content-Range: ${contentRange ?? "not provided"}`);
+  console.log(`Read ${result.bytes} byte(s)${result.truncated ? ` (stopped at the ${responseLimit}-byte limit)` : ""}.`);
+

+# KHInsider public-access feasibility probe
+
+This probe checks whether Node.js's built-in `fetch` can read a public KHInsider
+album page, find its numbered track-page links, and find an audio/download link
+on one track page. An optional bounded request checks whether that link returns
+audio data. It does not log in, use cookies, download a complete track, or retry
+failed requests.
+
+This is a feasibility probe, not the downloader. It tests Node `fetch`; if the
+application later uses a different HTTP client, repeat the check with that
+client before treating the result as proof for the implementation.
+
+## Run
+
+Requirements: Node.js 18.17 or newer and npm.
+
+From the repository root:
+
+```sh
+cd scripts
+npm install
+node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
+```
+
+The default URL is the Unreal II example from the project plan. To use another
+album, pass its URL. Add `--expected-tracks N` to require a known count:
+
+```sh
+node verify-khinsider-access.mjs 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/example' --expected-tracks 12
+```
+
+The first run checks the album and one track page but does not request the audio
+URL. To also test the audio endpoint, explicitly add `--probe-media`:
+
+```sh
+node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media
+```
+
+The media check sends `Range: bytes=0-0`. If the server honors ranges, it reads
+at most one byte. If the server ignores the range, the script reads at most
+65,536 bytes and cancels the response. That ceiling can be lowered, but not
+raised:
+
+```sh
+node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media --max-media-bytes 8192
+```
+
+For site operator contact details, optionally set a truthful user-agent suffix:
+
+```sh
+K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT='contact: you@example.org' node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
+```
+
+Review KHInsider's applicable terms and request guidance before running it. Run
+it once, manually, and stop if it reports HTTP 403, a login requirement, or a
+challenge. Do not add credentials, browser cookies, impersonation headers,
+challenge-solving, or retry loops to make the probe pass.
+
+## Interpreting results
+
+- `PASS` means the checks actually run succeeded. Without `--probe-media`, it
+  proves only that the pages and an audio link were discoverable.
+- A pass with `--probe-media` additionally confirms a bounded response with an
+  audio or generic-binary content type. Generic binary is weaker evidence; the
+  script warns if the link does not also identify an audio format.
+- `FAIL` includes page access denied, unexpected track-link counts, a missing
+  track/audio link, an unsafe redirect, or a non-audio response. Treat access
+  denial or a challenge as a feasibility stop, not as a signal to evade it.
+
+The script prints discovered public URLs to the terminal. Avoid sharing output
+if it contains information you do not want to disclose.
*** End Patch

#!/usr/bin/env node

import { lookup } from "node:dns/promises";
import { isIP } from "node:net";
import { parse } from "parse5";

const DEFAULT_ALBUM_URL =
  "https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack";
const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
const USER_AGENT = `K-Downloader-feasibility-probe/0.1${process.env.K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT ? ` (${process.env.K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT})` : ""}`;
const PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000;
const REDIRECT_LIMIT = 5;
const AUDIO_FORMATS = ["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"];

function usage() {
  console.log(`Usage: node verify-khinsider-access.mjs [album-url] [options]

Options:
  --expected-tracks N   Require exactly N discovered track links
  --probe-media         Make one bounded request to the first audio link found
  --max-media-bytes N   Maximum response bytes read (default: 65536; max: 65536)
  --help                Show this help

Without --probe-media, the script stops after resolving an audio link on one
track page. No login, cookies, or full audio downloads are used.`);
}

function parseArgs(args) {
  let albumUrl = DEFAULT_ALBUM_URL;
  let expectedTracks;
  let probeMedia = false;
  let maxMediaBytes = 65_536;
  let urlSeen = false;

  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
    const arg = args[index];
    if (arg === "--help") {
      usage();
      process.exit(0);
    } else if (arg === "--probe-media") {
      probeMedia = true;
    } else if (arg === "--expected-tracks" || arg === "--max-media-bytes") {
      const value = Number(args[index + 1]);
      if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
        throw new Error(`${arg} requires a positive integer`);
      }
      index += 1;
      if (arg === "--expected-tracks") expectedTracks = value;
      else maxMediaBytes = value;
    } else if (arg.startsWith("-")) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown option: ${arg}`);
    } else if (!urlSeen) {
      albumUrl = arg;
      urlSeen = true;
    } else {
      throw new Error("Provide at most one album URL");
    }
  }

  if (maxMediaBytes > 65_536) {
    throw new Error("--max-media-bytes cannot exceed 65536");
  }

  const parsedAlbumUrl = new URL(albumUrl);
  if (
    parsedAlbumUrl.protocol !== "https:" ||
    parsedAlbumUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
    parsedAlbumUrl.username ||
    parsedAlbumUrl.password ||
    !parsedAlbumUrl.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Album URL must be an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
  }

  return { albumUrl: parsedAlbumUrl, expectedTracks, probeMedia, maxMediaBytes };
}

function nodeText(node) {
  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(nodeText).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function* walk(node) {
  yield node;
  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
}

function attributes(node) {
  return Object.fromEntries((node.attrs ?? []).map(({ name, value }) => [name, value]));
}

function hrefFrom(node, baseUrl) {
  const href = attributes(node).href;
  if (!href) return undefined;
  try {
    const url = new URL(href, baseUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
    return url;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function numberedRow(row) {
  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
  return cells.some((cell) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(nodeText(cell)));
}

function findTracks(document, albumUrl) {
  const tracks = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const row of walk(document)) {
    if (row.tagName !== "tr" || !numberedRow(row)) continue;
    const rowLinks = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
    const candidates = rowLinks
      .map((node) => ({ node, url: hrefFrom(node, albumUrl), title: nodeText(node) }))
      .filter(({ url }) =>
        url &&
        url.hostname.toLowerCase() === SITE_HOST &&
        url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/") &&
        url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") !== albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") &&
        !url.pathname.startsWith("/cp/")
      );

    const chosen = candidates.find(({ title }) => title.length > 0) ?? candidates[0];
    if (chosen && !seen.has(chosen.url.href)) {
      seen.add(chosen.url.href);
      tracks.push({ title: chosen.title || `Track ${tracks.length + 1}`, url: chosen.url });
    }
  }
  return tracks;
}

function findAdvertisedTrackCount(document) {
  const text = nodeText(document);
  const match = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  return match ? Number(match[1]) : undefined;
}

function audioFormat(url, label) {
  const match = `${url.pathname} ${label}`.match(new RegExp(`\\b(${AUDIO_FORMATS.join("|")})\\b`, "i"));
  return match?.[1]?.toUpperCase();
}

function findAudioLinks(document, pageUrl) {
  const links = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const node of walk(document)) {
    let url;
    let label;
    if (node.tagName === "a") {
      url = hrefFrom(node, pageUrl);
      label = nodeText(node);
    } else if (node.tagName === "source" || node.tagName === "audio") {
      const attrs = attributes(node);
      url = attrs.src ? hrefFrom({ attrs: [{ name: "href", value: attrs.src }] }, pageUrl) : undefined;
      label = attrs.type ?? "audio source";
    }
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const format = audioFormat(url, label);
    if (format || /download/i.test(label)) {
      seen.add(url.href);
      links.push({ url, label: label || "audio download", format });
    }
  }
  return links;
}

function isPrivateAddress(address) {
  if (address.includes(":")) {
    const normalized = address.toLowerCase();
    return normalized === "::1" || normalized.startsWith("fc") || normalized.startsWith("fd") || normalized.startsWith("fe80:");
  }
  const octets = address.split(".").map(Number);
  return (
    octets[0] === 0 ||
    octets[0] === 10 ||
    octets[0] === 127 ||
    (octets[0] === 169 && octets[1] === 254) ||
    (octets[0] === 172 && octets[1] >= 16 && octets[1] <= 31) ||
    (octets[0] === 192 && octets[1] === 168) ||
    octets[0] >= 224
  );
}

async function validateMediaUrl(url) {
  const hostname = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (
    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    hostname === "localhost" ||
    hostname.endsWith(".localhost") ||
    hostname.endsWith(".local") ||
    hostname.endsWith(".internal")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing non-public or non-HTTPS media URL: ${url.origin}`);
  }

  if (isIP(hostname)) {
    if (isPrivateAddress(hostname)) throw new Error(`Refusing private media IP: ${hostname}`);
    return;
  }

  const addresses = await lookup(hostname, { all: true, verbatim: true });
  if (addresses.length === 0 || addresses.some(({ address }) => isPrivateAddress(address))) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media host that resolves to a private address: ${hostname}`);
  }
}

async function requestFollowingRedirects(initialUrl, { media = false, headers = {} } = {}) {
  let url = new URL(initialUrl);
  for (let redirectCount = 0; redirectCount <= REDIRECT_LIMIT; redirectCount += 1) {
    if (media) await validateMediaUrl(url);
    else if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST) {
      throw new Error(`Refusing album or track redirect outside https://${SITE_HOST}`);
    }

    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "user-agent": USER_AGENT, ...headers },
      redirect: "manual",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
    if (![301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(response.status)) return { response, url };

    const location = response.headers.get("location");
    await response.body?.cancel();
    if (!location) throw new Error(`Redirect from ${url.origin} did not include a Location header`);
    if (redirectCount === REDIRECT_LIMIT) throw new Error(`More than ${REDIRECT_LIMIT} redirects`);
    url = new URL(location, url);
  }
  throw new Error("Redirect limit exceeded");
}

async function readLimited(response, byteLimit) {
  if (!response.body) return { bytes: 0, truncated: false, data: Buffer.alloc(0) };
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let bytes = 0;
  let truncated = false;
  while (bytes < byteLimit) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    const remaining = byteLimit - bytes;
    const chunk = value.subarray(0, remaining);
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
    bytes += chunk.length;
    if (chunk.length < value.length || bytes === byteLimit) {
      truncated = true;
      await reader.cancel();
      break;
    }
  }
  return { bytes, truncated, data: Buffer.concat(chunks) };
}

async function fetchHtml(url) {
  const { response, url: finalUrl } = await requestFollowingRedirects(url);
  console.log(`GET ${url.href} -> HTTP ${response.status} (${finalUrl.href})`);
  if (!response.ok) {
    await response.body?.cancel();
    throw new Error(`Page request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "unknown";
  if (!contentType.toLowerCase().includes("text/html")) {
    await response.body?.cancel();
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTML page, received ${contentType}`);
  }
  const result = await readLimited(response, PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES);
  if (result.truncated) throw new Error(`HTML response exceeded ${PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES} bytes`);
  return { document: parse(result.data.toString("utf8")), finalUrl };
}

async function probeMedia(candidate, maxBytes) {
  console.log(`\nBounded media probe: ${candidate.url.href}`);
  const { response, url } = await requestFollowingRedirects(candidate.url, {
    media: true,
    headers: { range: "bytes=0-0" },
  });
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "unknown";
  const contentRange = response.headers.get("content-range");
  const responseLimit = response.status === 206 && /^bytes 0-0\//i.test(contentRange ?? "") ? 1 : maxBytes;
  const result = await readLimited(response, responseLimit);
  console.log(`GET with Range: bytes=0-0 -> HTTP ${response.status} (${url.href})`);
  console.log(`Content-Type: ${contentType}; Content-Range: ${contentRange ?? "not provided"}`);
  console.log(`Read ${result.bytes} byte(s)${result.truncated ? ` (stopped at the ${responseLimit}-byte limit)` : ""}.`);

  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Media request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
  if (/text\/html/i.test(contentType)) throw new Error("Media link returned HTML, not audio");
  if (!(contentType.toLowerCase().startsWith("audio/") || /application\/octet-stream/i.test(contentType))) {
    throw new Error(`Media response has an unexpected content type: ${contentType}`);
  }
  if (result.bytes === 0) throw new Error("Media endpoint returned no response bytes");
  if (/application\/octet-stream/i.test(contentType) && !candidate.format) {
    console.warn("Warning: generic binary content type; audio could not be confirmed from MIME type or link format.");
  }
}

async function main() {
  const options = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  console.log(`Probe user-agent: ${USER_AGENT}`);
  console.log("Authentication: none; cookies: none; automatic retries: none");
  console.log(`Album: ${options.albumUrl.href}\n`);

  const { document: albumDocument, finalUrl: albumFinalUrl } = await fetchHtml(options.albumUrl);
  const advertisedCount = findAdvertisedTrackCount(albumDocument);
  const tracks = findTracks(albumDocument, albumFinalUrl);
  console.log(`Advertised tracks: ${advertisedCount ?? "not found"}`);
  console.log(`Track-page links found in numbered rows: ${tracks.length}`);
  tracks.forEach((track, index) => console.log(`  ${index + 1}. ${track.title}: ${track.url.href}`));

  const expectedTracks = options.expectedTracks ?? advertisedCount;
  if (expectedTracks && tracks.length !== expectedTracks) {
    throw new Error(`Expected ${expectedTracks} track links but found ${tracks.length}`);
  }
  if (tracks.length === 0) throw new Error("No track-page links were found in numbered table rows");

  const track = tracks[0];
  console.log(`\nInspecting one track page: ${track.title}`);
  const { document: trackDocument, finalUrl: trackFinalUrl } = await fetchHtml(track.url);
  const audioLinks = findAudioLinks(trackDocument, trackFinalUrl);
  if (audioLinks.length === 0) throw new Error("No audio/download link was found on the track page");
  console.log(`Audio/download links found: ${audioLinks.length}`);
  audioLinks.forEach((link) => console.log(`  ${link.format ?? "format unknown"}: ${link.label} -> ${link.url.href}`));

  if (options.probeMedia) await probeMedia(audioLinks[0], options.maxMediaBytes);
  else console.log("\nMedia request not made. Re-run with --probe-media to test the first audio link.");

  console.log("\nRESULT: PASS for the checks performed.");
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(`\nRESULT: FAIL: ${error.message}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});

````
# KHInsider public-access feasibility probe

This probe checks whether Node.js's built-in `fetch` can read a public KHInsider
album page, find its numbered track-page links, and find an audio/download link
on one track page. An optional bounded request checks whether that link returns
audio data. It does not log in, use cookies, download a complete track, or retry
failed requests.

This is a feasibility probe, not the downloader. It tests Node `fetch`; if the
application later uses a different HTTP client, repeat the check with that
client before treating the result as proof for the implementation.

## Run

Requirements: Node.js 18.17 or newer and npm.

From the repository root:

```sh
cd scripts
npm install
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
```

The default URL is the Unreal II example from the project plan. To use another
album, pass its URL. Add `--expected-tracks N` to require a known count:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/example' --expected-tracks 12
```

The first run checks the album and one track page but does not request the audio
URL. To also test the audio endpoint, explicitly add `--probe-media`:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media
```

The media check sends `Range: bytes=0-0`. If the server honors ranges, it reads
at most one byte. If the server ignores the range, the script reads at most
65,536 bytes and cancels the response. That ceiling can be lowered, but not
raised:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media --max-media-bytes 8192
```

For site operator contact details, optionally set a truthful user-agent suffix:

```sh
K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT='contact: you@example.org' node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
```

Review KHInsider's applicable terms and request guidance before running it. Run
it once, manually, and stop if it reports HTTP 403, a login requirement, or a
challenge. Do not add credentials, browser cookies, impersonation headers,
challenge-solving, or retry loops to make the probe pass.

## Interpreting results

- `PASS` means the checks actually run succeeded. Without `--probe-media`, it
  proves only that the pages and an audio link were discoverable.
- A pass with `--probe-media` additionally confirms a bounded response with an
  audio or generic-binary content type. Generic binary is weaker evidence; the
  script warns if the link does not also identify an audio format.
- `FAIL` includes page access denied, unexpected track-link counts, a missing
  track/audio link, an unsafe redirect, or a non-audio response. Treat access
  denial or a challenge as a feasibility stop, not as a signal to evade it.

The script prints discovered public URLs to the terminal. Avoid sharing output
if it contains information you do not want to disclose.
````

- One request fetched a single byte at offset 57,548; the response reports a total size of 2,904,064 bytes (about 2.77 MiB).
- The other entry shows the full MP3 served from the browser’s disk cache.

So the track is streamable, and the browser has received the audio. What remains unverified is **automated discovery**: our Node probe gets 403 on the album page before it can extract track links. The screenshots don’t show the request headers, so they also don’t tell us what makes the browser’s album request succeed.

The next useful test is to make the same bounded range request from Node to the exact MP3 URL shown in DevTools. If that succeeds, media fetching works and album-page access/link discovery is the remaining blocker. If it fails, we’ll know the difference also affects the media request. The current script doesn’t accept a direct media URL yet, so that would need a small adjustment before testing it.

# KHInsider public-access feasibility probe

This probe checks whether Node.js's built-in `fetch` can read a public KHInsider
album page, find its numbered track-page links, and find an audio/download link
on one track page. An optional bounded request checks whether that link returns
audio data. It does not log in, use cookies, download a complete track, or retry
failed requests.

This is a feasibility probe, not the downloader. It tests Node `fetch`; if the
application later uses a different HTTP client, repeat the check with that
client before treating the result as proof for the implementation.

## Run

Requirements: Node.js 18.17 or newer and npm.

From the repository root:

```sh
cd scripts
npm install
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
```

The default URL is the Unreal II example from the project plan. To use another
album, pass its URL. Add `--expected-tracks N` to require a known count:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/example' --expected-tracks 12
```

The first run checks the album and one track page but does not request the audio
URL. To also test the audio endpoint, explicitly add `--probe-media`:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media
```

The media check sends `Range: bytes=0-0`. If the server honors ranges, it reads
at most one byte. If the server ignores the range, the script reads at most
65,536 bytes and cancels the response. That ceiling can be lowered, but not
raised:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media --max-media-bytes 8192
```

For site operator contact details, optionally set a truthful user-agent suffix:

```sh
K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT='contact: you@example.org' node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
```

Review KHInsider's applicable terms and request guidance before running it. Run
it once, manually, and stop if it reports HTTP 403, a login requirement, or a
challenge. Do not add credentials, browser cookies, impersonation headers,
challenge-solving, or r

#!/usr/bin/env node

import { lookup } from "node:dns/promises";
import { isIP } from "node:net";
import { parse } from "parse5";

const DEFAULT_ALBUM_URL =
  "https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack";
const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
const USER_AGENT = `K-Downloader-feasibility-probe/0.1${process.env.K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT ? ` (${process.env.K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT})` : ""}`;
const PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000;
const REDIRECT_LIMIT = 5;
const AUDIO_FORMATS = ["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"];

function usage() {
  console.log(`Usage: node verify-khinsider-access.mjs [album-url] [options]

Options:
  --media-url URL       Probe this media URL directly (no album-page request)
  --expected-tracks N   Require exactly N discovered track links
  --probe-media         Make one bounded request to the first audio link found
  --max-media-bytes N   Maximum response bytes read (default: 65536; max: 65536)
  --help                Show this help

Without --probe-media or --media-url, the script stops after resolving an audio
link on one track page. No login, cookies, or full audio downloads are used.`);
}

function parseArgs(args) {
  let albumUrl = DEFAULT_ALBUM_URL;
  let mediaUrl;
  let expectedTracks;
  let probeMedia = false;
  let maxMediaBytes = 65_536;
  let urlSeen = false;

  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
    const arg = args[index];
    if (arg === "--help") {
      usage();
      process.exit(0);
    } else if (arg === "--probe-media") {
      probeMedia = true;
    } else if (arg === "--media-url") {
      if (!args[index + 1]) throw new Error("--media-url requires a URL");
      mediaUrl = new URL(args[index + 1]);
      index += 1;
    } else if (arg === "--expected-tracks" || arg === "--max-media-bytes") {
      const value = Number(args[index + 1]);
      if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
        throw new Error(`${arg} requires a positive integer`);
      }
      index += 1;
      if (arg === "--expected-tracks") expectedTracks = value;
      else maxMediaBytes = value;
    } else if (arg.startsWith("-")) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown option: ${arg}`);
    } else if (!urlSeen) {
      albumUrl = arg;
      urlSeen = true;
    } else {
      throw new Error("Provide at most one album URL");
    }
  }

  if (maxMediaBytes > 65_536) {
    throw new Error("--max-media-bytes cannot exceed 65536");
  }

  if (mediaUrl) {
    if (urlSeen || probeMedia || expectedTracks !== undefined) {
      throw new Error("--media-url cannot be combined with an album URL, --probe-media, or --expected-tracks");
    }
    if (mediaUrl.protocol !== "https:" || mediaUrl.username || mediaUrl.password) {
      throw new Error("Media URL must use HTTPS and must not contain URL credentials");
    }
  } else {
    const parsedAlbumUrl = new URL(albumUrl);
    if (
      parsedAlbumUrl.protocol !== "https:" ||
      parsedAlbumUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
      parsedAlbumUrl.username ||
      parsedAlbumUrl.password ||
      !parsedAlbumUrl.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Album URL must be an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
    }
    albumUrl = parsedAlbumUrl;
  }

  return { albumUrl, mediaUrl, expectedTracks, probeMedia, maxMediaBytes };
}

function displayUrl(url) {
  return `${url.origin}${url.pathname}${url.search ? "?[redacted]" : ""}`;
}

function nodeText(node) {
  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(nodeText).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function* walk(node) {
  yield node;
  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
}

function attributes(node) {
  return Object.fromEntries((node.attrs ?? []).map(({ name, value }) => [name, value]));
}

function hrefFrom(node, baseUrl) {
  const href = attributes(node).href;
  if (!href) return undefined;
  try {
    const url = new URL(href, baseUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
    return url;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function numberedRow(row) {
  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
  return cells.some((cell) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(nodeText(cell)));
}

function findTracks(document, albumUrl) {
  const tracks = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const row of walk(document)) {
    if (row.tagName !== "tr" || !numberedRow(row)) continue;
    const rowLinks = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
    const candidates = rowLinks
      .map((node) => ({ node, url: hrefFrom(node, albumUrl), title: nodeText(node) }))
      .filter(({ url }) =>
        url &&
        url.hostname.toLowerCase() === SITE_HOST &&
        url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/") &&
        url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") !== albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") &&
        !url.pathname.startsWith("/cp/")
      );

    const chosen = candidates.find(({ title }) => title.length > 0) ?? candidates[0];
    if (chosen && !seen.has(chosen.url.href)) {
      seen.add(chosen.url.href);
      tracks.push({ title: chosen.title || `Track ${tracks.length + 1}`, url: chosen.url });
    }
  }
  return tracks;
}

function findAdvertisedTrackCount(document) {
  const text = nodeText(document);
  const match = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  return match ? Number(match[1]) : undefined;
}

function audioFormat(url, label) {
  const match = `${url.pathname} ${label}`.match(new RegExp(`\\b(${AUDIO_FORMATS.join("|")})\\b`, "i"));
  return match?.[1]?.toUpperCase();
}

function findAudioLinks(document, pageUrl) {
  const links = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const node of walk(document)) {
    let url;
    let label;
    if (node.tagName === "a") {
      url = hrefFrom(node, pageUrl);
      label = nodeText(node);
    } else if (node.tagName === "source" || node.tagName === "audio") {
      const attrs = attributes(node);
      url = attrs.src ? hrefFrom({ attrs: [{ name: "href", value: attrs.src }] }, pageUrl) : undefined;
      label = attrs.type ?? "audio source";
    }
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const format = audioFormat(url, label);
    if (format || /download/i.test(label)) {
      seen.add(url.href);
      links.push({ url, label: label || "audio download", format });
    }
  }
  return links;
}

function isPrivateAddress(address) {
  if (address.includes(":")) {
    const normalized = address.toLowerCase();
    return normalized === "::1" || normalized.startsWith("fc") || normalized.startsWith("fd") || normalized.startsWith("fe80:");
  }
  const octets = address.split(".").map(Number);
  return (
    octets[0] === 0 ||
    octets[0] === 10 ||
    octets[0] === 127 ||
    (octets[0] === 169 && octets[1] === 254) ||
    (octets[0] === 172 && octets[1] >= 16 && octets[1] <= 31) ||
    (octets[0] === 192 && octets[1] === 168) ||
    octets[0] >= 224
  );
}

async function validateMediaUrl(url) {
  const hostname = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (
    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    hostname === "localhost" ||
    hostname.endsWith(".localhost") ||
    hostname.endsWith(".local") ||
    hostname.endsWith(".internal")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing non-public or non-HTTPS media URL: ${url.origin}`);
  }

  if (isIP(hostname)) {
    if (isPrivateAddress(hostname)) throw new Error(`Refusing private media IP: ${hostname}`);
    return;
  }

  const addresses = await lookup(hostname, { all: true, verbatim: true });
  if (addresses.length === 0 || addresses.some(({ address }) => isPrivateAddress(address))) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media host that resolves to a private address: ${hostname}`);
  }
}

async function requestFollowingRedirects(initialUrl, { media = false, headers = {} } = {}) {
  let url = new URL(initialUrl);
  for (let redirectCount = 0; redirectCount <= REDIRECT_LIMIT; redirectCount += 1) {
    if (media) await validateMediaUrl(url);
    else if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST) {
      throw new Error(`Refusing album or track redirect outside https://${SITE_HOST}`);
    }

    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: { "user-agent": USER_AGENT, ...headers },
      redirect: "manual",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
    if (![301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(response.status)) return { response, url };

    const location = response.headers.get("location");
    await response.body?.cancel();
    if (!location) throw new Error(`Redirect from ${url.origin} did not include a Location header`);
    if (redirectCount === REDIRECT_LIMIT) throw new Error(`More than ${REDIRECT_LIMIT} redirects`);
    url = new URL(location, url);
  }
  throw new Error("Redirect limit exceeded");
}

async function readLimited(response, byteLimit) {
  if (!response.body) return { bytes: 0, truncated: false, data: Buffer.alloc(0) };
  const reader = response.body.getReader();
  const chunks = [];
  let bytes = 0;
  let truncated = false;
  while (bytes < byteLimit) {
    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    if (done) break;
    const remaining = byteLimit - bytes;
    const chunk = value.subarray(0, remaining);
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
    bytes += chunk.length;
    if (chunk.length < value.length || bytes === byteLimit) {
      truncated = true;
      await reader.cancel();
      break;
    }
  }
  return { bytes, truncated, data: Buffer.concat(chunks) };
}

async function fetchHtml(url) {
  const { response, url: finalUrl } = await requestFollowingRedirects(url);
  console.log(`GET ${displayUrl(url)} -> HTTP ${response.status} (${displayUrl(finalUrl)})`);
  if (!response.ok) {
    await response.body?.cancel();
    throw new Error(`Page request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "unknown";
  if (!contentType.toLowerCase().includes("text/html")) {
    await response.body?.cancel();
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTML page, received ${contentType}`);
  }
  const result = await readLimited(response, PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES);
  if (result.truncated) throw new Error(`HTML response exceeded ${PAGE_LIMIT_BYTES} bytes`);
  return { document: parse(result.data.toString("utf8")), finalUrl };
}

async function probeMedia(candidate, maxBytes) {
  console.log(`\nBounded media probe: ${displayUrl(candidate.url)}`);
  const { response, url } = await requestFollowingRedirects(candidate.url, {
    media: true,
    headers: { range: "bytes=0-0" },
  });
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "unknown";
  const contentRange = response.headers.get("content-range");
  const responseLimit = response.status === 206 && /^bytes 0-0\//i.test(contentRange ?? "") ? 1 : maxBytes;
  const result = await readLimited(response, responseLimit);
  console.log(`GET with Range: bytes=0-0 -> HTTP ${response.status} (${displayUrl(url)})`);
  console.log(`Content-Type: ${contentType}; Content-Range: ${contentRange ?? "not provided"}`);
  console.log(`Read ${result.bytes} byte(s)${result.truncated ? ` (stopped at the ${responseLimit}-byte limit)` : ""}.`);

  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Media request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
  if (/text\/html/i.test(contentType)) throw new Error("Media link returned HTML, not audio");
  if (!(contentType.toLowerCase().startsWith("audio/") || /application\/octet-stream/i.test(contentType))) {
    throw new Error(`Media response has an unexpected content type: ${contentType}`);
  }
  if (result.bytes === 0) throw new Error("Media endpoint returned no response bytes");
  if (/application\/octet-stream/i.test(contentType) && !candidate.format) {
    console.warn("Warning: generic binary content type; audio could not be confirmed from MIME type or link format.");
  }
}

async function main() {
  const options = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  console.log(`Probe user-agent: ${USER_AGENT}`);
  console.log("Authentication: none; cookies: none; automatic retries: none");
  if (options.mediaUrl) {
    const candidate = { url: options.mediaUrl, format: audioFormat(options.mediaUrl, "") };
    await probeMedia(candidate, options.maxMediaBytes);
    console.log("\nRESULT: PASS for the direct media check.");
    return;
  }

  console.log(`Album: ${displayUrl(options.albumUrl)}\n`);

  const { document: albumDocument, finalUrl: albumFinalUrl } = await fetchHtml(options.albumUrl);
  const advertisedCount = findAdvertisedTrackCount(albumDocument);
  const tracks = findTracks(albumDocument, albumFinalUrl);
  console.log(`Advertised tracks: ${advertisedCount ?? "not found"}`);
  console.log(`Track-page links found in numbered rows: ${tracks.length}`);
  tracks.forEach((track, index) => console.log(`  ${index + 1}. ${track.title}: ${displayUrl(track.url)}`));

  const expectedTracks = options.expectedTracks ?? advertisedCount;
  if (expectedTracks && tracks.length !== expectedTracks) {
    throw new Error(`Expected ${expectedTracks} track links but found ${tracks.length}`);
  }
  if (tracks.length === 0) throw new Error("No track-page links were found in numbered table rows");

  const track = tracks[0];
  console.log(`\nInspecting one track page: ${track.title}`);
  const { document: trackDocument, finalUrl: trackFinalUrl } = await fetchHtml(track.url);
  const audioLinks = findAudioLinks(trackDocument, trackFinalUrl);
  if (audioLinks.length === 0) throw new Error("No audio/download link was found on the track page");
  console.log(`Audio/download links found: ${audioLinks.length}`);
  audioLinks.forEach((link) => console.log(`  ${link.format ?? "format unknown"}: ${link.label} -> ${displayUrl(link.url)}`));

  if (options.probeMedia) await probeMedia(audioLinks[0], options.maxMediaBytes);
  else console.log("\nMedia request not made. Re-run with --probe-media to test the first audio link.");

  console.log("\nRESULT: PASS for the checks performed.");
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(`\nRESULT: FAIL: ${error.message}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});

````
# KHInsider public-access feasibility probe

This probe checks whether Node.js's built-in `fetch` can read a public KHInsider
album page, find its numbered track-page links, and find an audio/download link
on one track page. An optional bounded request checks whether that link returns
audio data. It does not log in, use cookies, download a complete track, or retry
failed requests.

This is a feasibility probe, not the downloader. It tests Node `fetch`; if the
application later uses a different HTTP client, repeat the check with that
client before treating the result as proof for the implementation.

## Run

Requirements: Node.js 18.17 or newer and npm.

From the repository root:

```sh
cd scripts
npm install
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
```

The default URL is the Unreal II example from the project plan. To use another
album, pass its URL. Add `--expected-tracks N` to require a known count:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/example' --expected-tracks 12
```

The first run checks the album and one track page but does not request the audio
URL. To also test the audio endpoint, explicitly add `--probe-media`:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media
```

The media check sends `Range: bytes=0-0`. If the server honors ranges, it reads
at most one byte. If the server ignores the range, the script reads at most
65,536 bytes and cancels the response. That ceiling can be lowered, but not
raised:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --probe-media --max-media-bytes 8192
```

To test a media URL copied from the browser without requesting the album page,
quote the URL and pass it to `--media-url`:

```sh
node verify-khinsider-access.mjs --media-url 'https://lambda.vgmtreasurechest.com/path/from/the/browser/01%20-%20Intro.mp3'
```

Replace the example URL with the exact request URL shown in DevTools. The direct
mode performs the same bounded range check and validates HTTPS, redirects, and
public host addresses. It does not send browser cookies. Query strings are
redacted in printed output in case the URL contains a temporary token.

For site operator contact details, optionally set a truthful user-agent suffix:

```sh
K_DOWNLOADER_CONTACT='contact: you@example.org' node verify-khinsider-access.mjs
```

Review KHInsider's applicable terms and request guidance before running it. Run
it once, manually, and stop if it reports HTTP 403, a login requirement, or a
challenge. Do not add credentials, browser cookies, impersonation headers,
challenge-solving, or retry loops to make the probe pass.

## Interpreting results

- `PASS` means the checks actually run succeeded. Without `--probe-media`, it
  proves only that the pages and an audio link were discoverable.
- A pass with `--probe-media` additionally confirms a bounded response with an
  audio or generic-binary content type. Generic binary is weaker evidence; the
  script warns if the link does not also identify an audio format.
- `FAIL` includes page access denied, unexpected track-link counts, a missing
  track/audio link, an unsafe redirect, or a non-audio response. Treat access
  denial or a challenge as a feasibility stop, not as a signal to evade it.

The script prints discovered public URLs to the terminal. Avoid sharing output
if it contains information you do not want to disclose.
````

I found the site’s FAQ, terms page, and `robots.txt`. There’s no explicit automation rule in the terms or robots file, but the FAQ makes a clear distinction between individual song downloads and full-album mass downloads because of bandwidth; I’m weighing that caveat in the recommendation.

Yes. I checked the site’s [FAQ](https://downloads.khinsider.com/faq), [Terms and rules](https://downloads.khinsider.com/forums/index.php?help/terms/), and [robots.txt](https://downloads.khinsider.com/robots.txt).

I found **no explicit rule granting or forbidding automated access** in the terms or robots file; `robots.txt` only disallows `/unavailable`. But the FAQ says individual downloads are song-by-song because unrestricted mass downloads drove bandwidth use sharply higher, and full-album downloads are now tied to giving back to the site. That makes automating every track in an album potentially contrary to the distinction the site is trying to enforce, even though individual track links work without login.

So the technical path is proven, but permission to automate a whole album is not. Before implementing that workflow, I recommend asking the site through its [contact form](https://downloads.khinsider.com/forums/index.php?misc/contact/), specifically whether sequential automation of public individual-track links for one album is allowed and what request pacing they expect.

I’ll make the first implementation slice a public-mode discovery CLI, not the whole app yet: a fresh Playwright browser context with no stored login state will load the album, parse numbered track links, visit the first track page, and print its discovered formats/link host. I’ll add parser fixtures and unit tests so page-structure changes can be caught without routine live downloads; the immediate disconfirming check is whether this code parses the known 19-track album shape and passes tests.

+import { chromium } from "playwright";
+import { parse } from "parse5";
+
+const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
+const AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = new Set(["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"]);
+
+export type TrackLink = {
+  number: number;
+  title: string;
+  pageUrl: URL;
+};
+
+export type AudioLink = {
+  format: string;
+  url: URL;
+};
+
+export type AlbumPage = {
+  title: string;
+  advertisedTrackCount?: number;
+  tracks: TrackLink[];
+};
+
+function* walk(node: any): Generator<any> {
+  yield node;
+  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
+}
+
+function textContent(node: any): string {
+  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
+  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(textContent).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
+}
+
+function href(node: any, baseUrl: URL): URL | undefined {
+  const value = node.attrs?.find((attribute: any) => attribute.name === "href")?.value;
+  if (!value) return undefined;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(value, baseUrl);
+    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
+    return url;
+  } catch {
+    return undefined;
+  }
+}
+
+function numberedTrack(row: any, albumUrl: URL): TrackLink | undefined {
+  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
+  const numberCell = cells.map((cell: any) => textContent(cell)).find((text: string) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(text));
+  if (!numberCell) return undefined;
+
+  const anchors = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
+  for (const anchor of anchors) {
+    const pageUrl = href(anchor, albumUrl);
+    if (
+      !pageUrl ||
+      pageUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
+      !pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`)
+    ) continue;
+
+    const title = textContent(anchor);
+    if (!title) continue;
+    return { number: Number.parseInt(numberCell, 10), title, pageUrl };
+  }
+  return undefined;
+}
+
+export function validateAlbumUrl(input: string): URL {
+  const url = new URL(input);

import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { parse } from "parse5";

const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
const AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = new Set(["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"]);

export type TrackLink = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  pageUrl: URL;
};

export type AudioLink = {
  format: string;
  url: URL;
};

export type AlbumPage = {
  title: string;
  advertisedTrackCount?: number;
  tracks: TrackLink[];
};

function* walk(node: any): Generator<any> {
  yield node;
  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
}

function textContent(node: any): string {
  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(textContent).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function href(node: any, baseUrl: URL): URL | undefined {
  const value = node.attrs?.find((attribute: any) => attribute.name === "href")?.value;
  if (!value) return undefined;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value, baseUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
    return url;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function numberedTrack(row: any, albumUrl: URL): TrackLink | undefined {
  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
  const numberCell = cells.map((cell: any) => textContent(cell)).find((text: string) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(text));
  if (!numberCell) return undefined;

  const anchors = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
  for (const anchor of anchors) {
    const pageUrl = href(anchor, albumUrl);
    if (
      !pageUrl ||
      pageUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
      !pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`)
    ) continue;

    const title = textContent(anchor);
    if (!title) continue;
    return { number: Number.parseInt(numberCell, 10), title, pageUrl };
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function validateAlbumUrl(input: string): URL {
  const url = new URL(input);
  if (
    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
    url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    !url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url;
}

export function parseAlbumPage(html: string, albumUrl: URL): AlbumPage {
  const document = parse(html);
  const text = textContent(document);
  const advertisedMatch = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  const heading = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "h2" || node.tagName === "h1");
  const tracks = [...walk(document)]
    .filter((node) => node.tagName === "tr")
    .map((row) => numberedTrack(row, albumUrl))
    .filter((track): track is TrackLink => track !== undefined);

  return {
    title: heading ? textContent(heading) : albumUrl.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? "Album",
    advertisedTrackCount: advertisedMatch ? Number(advertisedMatch[1]) : undefined,
    tracks,
  };
}

export function parseTrackPage(html: string, trackUrl: URL): AudioLink[] {
  const document = parse(html);
  const links: AudioLink[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const anchor of walk(document).filter((node) => node.tagName === "a")) {
    const label = textContent(anchor);
    if (!/click here to download as/i.test(label)) continue;
    const url = href(anchor, trackUrl);
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const extension = url.pathname.split(".").at(-1)?.toLowerCase();
    const format = extension && AUDIO_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ? extension.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    if (!format) continue;
    seen.add(url.href);
    links.push({ format, url });
  }

  return links;
}

export async function inspectAlbum(input: string): Promise<{ album: AlbumPage; firstTrackAudio: AudioLink[] }> {
  const albumUrl = validateAlbumUrl(input);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ serviceWorkers: "block" });

  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const albumResponse = await page.goto(albumUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!albumResponse || !albumResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Album page request failed with HTTP ${albumResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    const album = parseAlbumPage(await albumResponse.text(), albumUrl);
    if (album.advertisedTrackCount !== undefined && album.tracks.length !== album.advertisedTrackCount) {
      throw new Error(`Album advertises ${album.advertisedTrackCount} tracks but ${album.tracks.length} track links were found`);
    }
    const firstTrack = album.tracks[0];
    if (!firstTrack) throw new Error("No numbered track-page links were found");

    const trackResponse = await page.goto(firstTrack.pageUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!trackResponse || !trackResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Track page request failed with HTTP ${trackResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    return { album, firstTrackAudio: parseTrackPage(await trackResponse.text(), firstTrack.pageUrl) };
  } finally {
    await context.close();
    await browser.close();
  }
}

import { inspectAlbum } from "./khinsider.js";

function usage(): never {
  console.error("Usage: npm run inspect -- <album-url>");
  process.exit(2);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const [command, albumUrl, ...extra] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (command !== "inspect" || !albumUrl || extra.length > 0) usage();

  const { album, firstTrackAudio } = await inspectAlbum(albumUrl);
  console.log(`Album: ${album.title}`);
  console.log(`Tracks: ${album.tracks.length}${album.advertisedTrackCount ? ` / ${album.advertisedTrackCount}` : ""}`);
  console.log(`First track: ${album.tracks[0].number}. ${album.tracks[0].title}`);
  if (firstTrackAudio.length === 0) {
    console.log("Audio links: none recognized");
    process.exitCode = 1;
    return;
  }
  for (const link of firstTrackAudio) console.log(`  ${link.format}: ${link.url.origin}${link.url.pathname}`);
  console.log("Discovery check passed; no audio was downloaded.");
}

main().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.error(`Discovery failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});

function numberedTrack(row: any, albumUrl: URL): TrackLink | undefined {
  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
  const numberCell = cells.map((cell: any) => textContent(cell)).find((text: string) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(text));
  if (!numberCell) return undefined;

  const anchors = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
  for (const anchor of anchors) {
    const pageUrl = href(anchor, albumUrl);
    if (
      !pageUrl ||
      pageUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
      !pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`)
    ) continue;

    const title = textContent(anchor);
    if (!title) continue;
    return { number: Number.parseInt(numberCell, 10), title, pageUrl };
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function validateAlbumUrl(input: string): URL {
  const url = new URL(input);
  if (
    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
    url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    !url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url;
}

export function parseAlbumPage(html: string, albumUrl: URL): AlbumPage {
  const document = parse(html);
  const text = textContent(document);
  const advertisedMatch = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  const heading = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "h2" || node.tagName === "h1");
  const tracks = [...walk(document)]
    .filter((node) => node.tagName === "tr")
    .map((row) => numberedTrack(row, albumUrl))
    .filter((track): track is TrackLink => track !== undefined);

  return {
    title: heading ? textContent(heading) : albumUrl.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? "Album",
    advertisedTrackCount: advertisedMatch ? Number(advertisedMatch[1]) : undefined,
    tracks,
  };
}

export function parseTrackPage(html: string, trackUrl: URL): AudioLink[] {
  const document = parse(html);
  const links: AudioLink[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const anchor of [...walk(document)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a")) {
    const label = textContent(anchor);
    if (!/click here to download as/i.test(label)) continue;
    const url = href(anchor, trackUrl);
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const extension = url.pathname.split(".").at(-1)?.toLowerCase();
    const format = extension && AUDIO_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ? extension.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    if (!format) continue;
    seen.add(url.href);
    links.push({ format, url });
  }

  return links;
}

export async function inspectAlbum(input: string): Promise<{ album: AlbumPage; firstTrackAudio: AudioLink[] }> {
  const albumUrl = validateAlbumUrl(input);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ serviceWorkers: "block" });

  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const albumResponse = await page.goto(albumUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!albumResponse || !albumResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Album page request failed with HTTP ${albumResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    const album = parseAlbumPage(await albumResponse.text(), albumUrl);
    if (album.advertisedTrackCount !== undefined && album.tracks.length !== album.advertisedTrackCount) {
      throw new Error(`Album advertises ${album.advertisedTrackCount} tracks but ${album.tracks.length} track links were found`);
    }
    const firstTrack = album.tracks[0];
    if (!firstTrack) throw new Error("No numbered track-page links were found");

    const trackResponse = await page.goto(firstTrack.pageUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!trackResponse || !trackResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Track page request failed with HTTP ${trackResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    return { album, firstTrackAudio: parseTrackPage(await trackResponse.text(), firstTrack.pageUrl) };
  } finally {
    await context.close();
    await browser.close();
  }
}

import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { parse } from "parse5";

const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
const AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = new Set(["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"]);

export type TrackLink = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  pageUrl: URL;
};

export type AudioLink = {
  format: string;
  url: URL;
};

export type AlbumPage = {
  title: string;
  advertisedTrackCount?: number;
  tracks: TrackLink[];
};

function* walk(node: any): Generator<any> {
  yield node;
  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
}

function textContent(node: any): string {
  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(textContent).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function href(node: any, baseUrl: URL): URL | undefined {
  const value = node.attrs?.find((attribute: any) => attribute.name === "href")?.value;
  if (!value) return undefined;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value, baseUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
    return url;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function numberedTrack(row: any, albumUrl: URL): TrackLink | undefined {
  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
  const numberCell = cells.map((cell: any) => textContent(cell)).find((text: string) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(text));
  if (!numberCell) return undefined;

  const anchors = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
  for (const anchor of anchors) {
    const pageUrl = href(anchor, albumUrl);
    if (
      !pageUrl ||
      pageUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
      !pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`)
    ) continue;

    const title = textContent(anchor);
    if (!title) continue;
    return { number: Number.parseInt(numberCell, 10), title, pageUrl };
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function validateAlbumUrl(input: string): URL {
  const url = new URL(input);
  if (
    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
    url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    !url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url;
}

export function parseAlbumPage(html: string, albumUrl: URL): AlbumPage {
  const document = parse(html);
  const text = textContent(document);
  const advertisedMatch = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  const heading = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "h2" || node.tagName === "h1");
  const tracks = [...walk(document)]
    .filter((node) => node.tagName === "tr")
    .map((row) => numberedTrack(row, albumUrl))
    .filter((track): track is TrackLink => track !== undefined);

  return {
    title: heading ? textContent(heading) : albumUrl.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? "Album",
    advertisedTrackCount: advertisedMatch ? Number(advertisedMatch[1]) : undefined,
    tracks,
  };
}

export function parseTrackPage(html: string, trackUrl: URL): AudioLink[] {
  const document = parse(html);
  const links: AudioLink[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const anchor of [...walk(document)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a")) {
    const label = textContent(anchor);
    if (!/click here to download as/i.test(label)) continue;
    const url = href(anchor, trackUrl);
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const extension = url.pathname.split(".").at(-1)?.toLowerCase();
    const format = extension && AUDIO_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ? extension.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    if (!format) continue;
    seen.add(url.href);
    links.push({ format, url });
  }

  return links;
}

export async function inspectAlbum(input: string): Promise<{ album: AlbumPage; firstTrackAudio: AudioLink[] }> {
  const albumUrl = validateAlbumUrl(input);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: false });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ serviceWorkers: "block" });

  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const albumResponse = await page.goto(albumUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!albumResponse || !albumResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Album page request failed with HTTP ${albumResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    const album = parseAlbumPage(await albumResponse.text(), albumUrl);
    if (album.advertisedTrackCount !== undefined && album.tracks.length !== album.advertisedTrackCount) {
      throw new Error(`Album advertises ${album.advertisedTrackCount} tracks but ${album.tracks.length} track links were found`);
    }
    const firstTrack = album.tracks[0];
    if (!firstTrack) throw new Error("No numbered track-page links were found");

    const trackResponse = await page.goto(firstTrack.pageUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!trackResponse || !trackResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Track page request failed with HTTP ${trackResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    return { album, firstTrackAudio: parseTrackPage(await trackResponse.text(), firstTrack.pageUrl) };
  } finally {
    await context.close();
    await browser.close();
  }
}

# K-Downloader

K-Downloader is a Linux-first KHInsider album downloader. The first implemented
slice is public album and track-link discovery; audio transfer, queue recovery,
GUI, optional account features, and packaging are not implemented yet.

## Discovery check

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer, npm, and a graphical desktop session.

```sh
npm install
npx playwright install chromium
npm run inspect -- 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack'
```

The command opens a fresh visible Chromium context without a stored browser
profile, visits the album and its first track page, and prints the discovered
track count and audio link. It does not sign in or download audio. This visible
mode is currently needed: plain Node fetch and headless Chromium received HTTP
403 during feasibility checks, while a fresh visible Chromium context succeeded.
No attempt is made to imitate a browser or evade a challenge. If access is denied
or a challenge appears, stop and review the site's permitted access methods.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run build
```
