```
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { parse } from "parse5";

const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
const AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = new Set(["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"]);

export type TrackLink = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  pageUrl: URL;
};

export type AudioLink = {
  format: string;
  url: URL;
};

export type AlbumPage = {
  title: string;
  advertisedTrackCount?: number;
  tracks: TrackLink[];
};

function* walk(node: any): Generator<any> {
  yield node;
  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
}

function textContent(node: any): string {
  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(textContent).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function href(node: any, baseUrl: URL): URL | undefined {
  const value = node.attrs?.find((attribute: any) => attribute.name === "href")?.value;
  if (!value) return undefined;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value, baseUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
    return url;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function numberedTrack(row: any, albumUrl: URL): TrackLink | undefined {
  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
  const numberCell = cells.map((cell: any) => textContent(cell)).find((text: string) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(text));
  if (!numberCell) return undefined;

  const anchors = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
  for (const anchor of anchors) {
    const pageUrl = href(anchor, albumUrl);
    if (
      !pageUrl ||
      pageUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
      !pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`)
    ) continue;

    const title = textContent(anchor);
    if (!title) continue;
    return { number: Number.parseInt(numberCell, 10), title, pageUrl };
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function validateAlbumUrl(input: string): URL {
  const url = new URL(input);
  if (
    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
    url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    !url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url;
}

export function parseAlbumPage(html: string, albumUrl: URL): AlbumPage {
  const document = parse(html);
  const text = textContent(document);
  const advertisedMatch = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  const pageTitle = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "title");
  const titleMatch = pageTitle && textContent(pageTitle).match(
    /^(.*?)\s+(?:MP3|FLAC|OGG|OPUS|M4A|AAC|WAV|WMA|ALAC)\s+-\s+Download Soundtracks/i,
  );
  const heading = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "h2" || node.tagName === "h1");
  const tracks = [...walk(document)]
    .filter((node) => node.tagName === "tr")
    .map((row) => numberedTrack(row, albumUrl))
    .filter((track): track is TrackLink => track !== undefined);

  return {
    title: titleMatch?.[1] ?? (heading ? textContent(heading) : albumUrl.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? "Album"),
    advertisedTrackCount: advertisedMatch ? Number(advertisedMatch[1]) : undefined,
    tracks,
  };
}

export function parseTrackPage(html: string, trackUrl: URL): AudioLink[] {
  const document = parse(html);
  const links: AudioLink[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const anchor of [...walk(document)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a")) {
    const label = textContent(anchor);
    if (!/click here to download as/i.test(label)) continue;
    const url = href(anchor, trackUrl);
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const extension = url.pathname.split(".").at(-1)?.toLowerCase();
    const format = extension && AUDIO_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ? extension.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    if (!format) continue;
    seen.add(url.href);
    links.push({ format, url });
  }

  return links;
}

export async function inspectAlbum(input: string): Promise<{ album: AlbumPage; firstTrackAudio: AudioLink[] }> {
  const albumUrl = validateAlbumUrl(input);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: false });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ serviceWorkers: "block" });

  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const albumResponse = await page.goto(albumUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!albumResponse || !albumResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Album page request failed with HTTP ${albumResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    const album = parseAlbumPage(await albumResponse.text(), albumUrl);
    if (album.advertisedTrackCount !== undefined && album.tracks.length !== album.advertisedTrackCount) {
      throw new Error(`Album advertises ${album.advertisedTrackCount} tracks but ${album.tracks.length} track links were found`);
    }
    const firstTrack = album.tracks[0];
    if (!firstTrack) throw new Error("No numbered track-page links were found");

    const trackResponse = await page.goto(firstTrack.pageUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!trackResponse || !trackResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Track page request failed with HTTP ${trackResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    return { album, firstTrackAudio: parseTrackPage(await trackResponse.text(), firstTrack.pageUrl) };
  } finally {
    await context.close();
    await browser.close();
  }
}
```

import { inspectAlbum } from "./khinsider.js";

function usage(): never {
  console.error("Usage: npm run inspect -- <album-url>");
  process.exit(2);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const [command, albumUrl, ...extra] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (command !== "inspect" || !albumUrl || extra.length > 0) usage();

  const { album, firstTrackAudio } = await inspectAlbum(albumUrl);
  console.log(`Album: ${album.title}`);
  console.log(`Tracks: ${album.tracks.length}${album.advertisedTrackCount ? ` / ${album.advertisedTrackCount}` : ""}`);
  console.log(`First track: ${album.tracks[0].number}. ${album.tracks[0].title}`);
  if (firstTrackAudio.length === 0) {
    console.log("Audio links: none recognized");
    process.exitCode = 1;
    return;
  }
  for (const link of firstTrackAudio) console.log(`  ${link.format}: ${link.url.origin}${link.url.pathname}`);
  console.log("Discovery check passed; no audio was downloaded.");
}

main().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.error(`Discovery failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { parseAlbumPage, parseTrackPage, validateAlbumUrl } from "../src/khinsider.js";

const albumUrl = new URL("https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/fixture-album");
const albumHtml = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("./fixtures/album.html", import.meta.url)), "utf8");
const trackHtml = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("./fixtures/track.html", import.meta.url)), "utf8");

describe("KHInsider page parsing", () => {
  it("keeps ordered track-page links and ignores bulk and recommendation links", () => {
    const result = parseAlbumPage(albumHtml, albumUrl);
    expect(result.title).toBe("Fixture Album");
    expect(result.advertisedTrackCount).toBe(2);
    expect(result.tracks.map(({ number, title }) => [number, title])).toEqual([
      [1, "Opening"],
      [2, "Finale"],
    ]);
    expect(result.tracks.every(({ pageUrl }) => pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname}/`))).toBe(true);
  });

  it("extracts only explicit audio-download links and their format", () => {
    const result = parseTrackPage(trackHtml, new URL(`${albumUrl.href}/01-Opening.mp3`));
    expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result[0].format).toBe("MP3");
    expect(result[0].url.hostname).toBe("media.example.test");
  });

  it("rejects unrelated or insecure album URLs", () => {
    expect(() => validateAlbumUrl("http://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/test")).toThrow();
    expect(() => validateAlbumUrl("https://example.com/game-soundtracks/album/test")).toThrow();
  });
});

    !url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url;
}

export function parseAlbumPage(html: string, albumUrl: URL): AlbumPage {
  const document = parse(html);
  const text = textContent(document);
  const advertisedMatch = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  const pageTitle = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "title");
  const titleMatch = pageTitle && textContent(pageTitle).match(
    /^(.*?)\s+(?:MP3|FLAC|OGG|OPUS|M4A|AAC|WAV|WMA|ALAC)\s+-\s+Download Soundtracks/i,
  );
  const heading = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "h2" || node.tagName === "h1");
  const tracks = [...walk(document)]
    .filter((node) => node.tagName === "tr")
    .map((row) => numberedTrack(row, albumUrl))
    .filter((track): track is TrackLink => track !== undefined);

  return {
    title: titleMatch?.[1] ?? (heading ? textContent(heading) : albumUrl.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? "Album"),
    advertisedTrackCount: advertisedMatch ? Number(advertisedMatch[1]) : undefined,
    tracks,
  };
}

export function parseTrackPage(html: string, trackUrl: URL): AudioLink[] {
  const document = parse(html);
  const links: AudioLink[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const anchor of [...walk(document)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a")) {
    const label = textContent(anchor);
    if (!/click here to download as/i.test(label)) continue;
    const url = href(anchor, trackUrl);
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const extension = url.pathname.split(".").at(-1)?.toLowerCase();
    const format = extension && AUDIO_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ? extension.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    if (!format) continue;
    seen.add(url.href);
    links.push({ format, url });
  }

  return links;
}

export async function inspectAlbum(input: string): Promise<{ album: AlbumPage; tracks: DiscoveredTrack[] }> {
  const albumUrl = validateAlbumUrl(input);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: false });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ serviceWorkers: "block" });

  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const albumResponse = await page.goto(albumUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!albumResponse || !albumResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Album page request failed with HTTP ${albumResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    const album = parseAlbumPage(await albumResponse.text(), albumUrl);
    if (album.advertisedTrackCount !== undefined && album.tracks.length !== album.advertisedTrackCount) {
      throw new Error(`Album advertises ${album.advertisedTrackCount} tracks but ${album.tracks.length} track links were found`);
    }
    if (album.tracks.length === 0) throw new Error("No numbered track-page links were found");

    const tracks: DiscoveredTrack[] = [];
    for (const [index, track] of album.tracks.entries()) {
      if (index > 0) await page.waitForTimeout(1_000);
      const trackResponse = await page.goto(track.pageUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
      if (!trackResponse || !trackResponse.ok()) {
        throw new Error(`Track ${track.number} page request failed with HTTP ${trackResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
      }
      tracks.push({ ...track, audioLinks: parseTrackPage(await trackResponse.text(), track.pageUrl) });
    }

    return { album, tracks };
  } finally {
    await context.close();
    await browser.close();
  }
}

import type { AudioLink, DiscoveredTrack } from "./khinsider.js";

const LOSSLESS_PREFERENCE = ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"];

export type FormatPolicy =
  | { kind: "prefer-lossless" }
  | { kind: "lossless-only"; skipUnavailable?: boolean }
  | { kind: "specific"; format: string; skipUnavailable?: boolean };

export type TrackFormatSelection = {
  track: DiscoveredTrack;
  selected?: AudioLink;
  state: "ready" | "skipped" | "unavailable";
  reason?: string;
};

export type FormatPlan = {
  tracks: TrackFormatSelection[];
  blocked: boolean;
  incomplete: boolean;
};

function selectLossless(links: AudioLink[]): AudioLink | undefined {
  for (const format of LOSSLESS_PREFERENCE) {
    const match = links.find((link) => link.format.toUpperCase() === format);
    if (match) return match;
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function planFormats(tracks: DiscoveredTrack[], policy: FormatPolicy): FormatPlan {
  const planned = tracks.map((track): TrackFormatSelection => {
    let selected: AudioLink | undefined;
    if (policy.kind === "prefer-lossless") {
      selected = selectLossless(track.audioLinks)
        ?? track.audioLinks.find((link) => link.format.toUpperCase() === "MP3")
        ?? track.audioLinks[0];
      if (selected) return { track, selected, state: "ready" };
      return { track, state: "unavailable", reason: "No audio format was discovered" };
    }

    const requested = policy.kind === "specific" ? policy.format.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    selected = requested
      ? track.audioLinks.find((link) => link.format.toUpperCase() === requested)
      : selectLossless(track.audioLinks);
    if (selected) return { track, selected, state: "ready" };

    const reason = requested ? `${requested} is unavailable` : "No lossless format is available";
    return policy.skipUnavailable
      ? { track, state: "skipped", reason }
      : { track, state: "unavailable", reason };
  });

  const unavailable = planned.some((selection) => selection.state === "unavailable");
  const skipped = planned.some((selection) => selection.state === "skipped");
  return {
    tracks: planned,
    blocked: unavailable,
    incomplete: skipped,
  };
}

import { createWriteStream } from "node:fs";
import { link, lookup as dnsLookup, lstat, mkdir, rm, stat, unlink } from "node:fs/promises";
import { isIP } from "node:net";
import { Readable } from "node:stream";
import { pipeline } from "node:stream/promises";

const REDIRECT_LIMIT = 5;
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;

export type TransferOptions = {
  allowedHosts: ReadonlySet<string>;
  expectedFormat: string;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
  resolveAddresses?: (hostname: string) => Promise<Array<{ address: string; family: number }>>;
};

export type TransferResult = {
  bytes: number;
  contentType: string;
};

function isPrivateAddress(address: string): boolean {
  if (address.includes(":")) {
    const normalized = address.toLowerCase();
    const mappedIpv4 = normalized.match(/^::ffff:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$/);
    if (mappedIpv4) return isPrivateAddress(mappedIpv4[1]);
    if (normalized === "::" || normalized === "::1") return true;
    const firstSegment = Number.parseInt(normalized.split(":")[0] || "0", 16);
    return firstSegment === 0 ||
      (firstSegment >= 0xfc00 && firstSegment <= 0xfdff) ||
      (firstSegment >= 0xfe80 && firstSegment <= 0xfebf) ||
      firstSegment >= 0xff00;
  }

  const octets = address.split(".").map(Number);
  if (octets.length !== 4 || octets.some((octet) => !Number.isInteger(octet) || octet < 0 || octet > 255)) return true;
  return octets[0] === 0 || octets[0] === 10 || octets[0] === 127 || octets[0] >= 224 ||
    (octets[0] === 169 && octets[1] === 254) ||
    (octets[0] === 172 && octets[1] >= 16 && octets[1] <= 31) ||
    (octets[0] === 192 && octets[1] === 168);
}

async function validateMediaUrl(
  url: URL,
  allowedHosts: ReadonlySet<string>,
  resolveAddresses: NonNullable<TransferOptions["resolveAddresses"]>,
): Promise<void> {
  const hostname = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || !allowedHosts.has(hostname)) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media URL outside the approved HTTPS hosts: ${url.origin}`);
  }
  if (isIP(hostname)) {
    if (isPrivateAddress(hostname)) throw new Error(`Refusing private media IP: ${hostname}`);
    return;
  }
  const addresses = await resolveAddresses(hostname);
  if (addresses.length === 0 || addresses.some(({ address }) => isPrivateAddress(address))) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media host that resolves to a private address: ${hostname}`);
  }
}

async function requestMedia(url: URL, options: TransferOptions): Promise<Response> {
  const fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  const resolveAddresses = options.resolveAddresses ?? ((hostname) => dnsLookup(hostname, { all: true }));
  let currentUrl = url;

  for (let redirectCount = 0; redirectCount <= REDIRECT_LIMIT; redirectCount += 1) {
    await validateMediaUrl(currentUrl, options.allowedHosts, resolveAddresses);
    const signals = [AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)];
    if (options.signal) signals.push(options.signal);
    const response = await fetchImpl(currentUrl, {
      method: "GET",
      redirect: "manual",
      signal: AbortSignal.any(signals),
    });
    if (![301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(response.status)) return response;

    const location = response.headers.get("location");
    await response.body?.cancel();
    if (!location) throw new Error("Media redirect did not include a Location header");
    if (redirectCount === REDIRECT_LIMIT) throw new Error(`More than ${REDIRECT_LIMIT} media redirects`);
    currentUrl = new URL(location, currentUrl);
  }
  throw new Error("Media redirect limit exceeded");
}

async function pathExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function streamMediaToFile(
  mediaUrl: URL,
  outputPath: string,
  options: TransferOptions,
): Promise<TransferResult> {
  if (await pathExists(outputPath)) throw new Error(`File already exists: ${outputPath}`);
  const partialPath = `${outputPath}.part`;
  if (await pathExists(partialPath)) throw new Error(`Partial file already exists: ${partialPath}`);

  await mkdir(new URL(`file://${outputPath}`).pathname.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, ""), { recursive: true });
  let response: Response | undefined;
  let partialCreated = false;
  try {
    response = await requestMedia(mediaUrl, options);
    if (response.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Media request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
    const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
    if (!(contentType.startsWith("audio/") || contentType === "application/octet-stream")) {
      await response.body?.cancel();
      throw new Error(`Expected audio data, received ${contentType || "unknown content type"}`);
    }
    if (!response.body) throw new Error("Media response has no body");

    const contentLengthHeader = response.headers.get("content-length");
    const expectedLength = contentLengthHeader && /^\d+$/.test(contentLengthHeader)
      ? Number(contentLengthHeader)
      : undefined;
    const source = Readable.fromWeb(response.body as import("node:stream/web").ReadableStream);
    partialCreated = true;
    await pipeline(source, createWriteStream(partialPath, { flags: "wx" }), {
      signal: options.signal,
    });
    const file = await stat(partialPath);
    if (file.size === 0) throw new Error("Media response was empty");
    if (expectedLength !== undefined && file.size !== expectedLength) {
      throw new Error(`Incomplete media response: expected ${expectedLength} bytes, received ${file.size}`);
    }

    await link(partialPath, outputPath);
    await unlink(partialPath);
    partialCreated = false;
    return { bytes: file.size, contentType };
  } catch (error) {
    await response?.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
    if (partialCreated) await rm(partialPath, { force: true });
    throw error;
  }
}

import { createWriteStream } from "node:fs";
import { link, lstat, mkdir, rm, stat, unlink } from "node:fs/promises";
import { lookup as dnsLookup } from "node:dns/promises";
import { isIP } from "node:net";
import { dirname } from "node:path";
import { Readable } from "node:stream";
import { pipeline } from "node:stream/promises";

const REDIRECT_LIMIT = 5;
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;

export type TransferOptions = {
  allowedHosts: ReadonlySet<string>;
  expectedFormat: string;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
  resolveAddresses?: (hostname: string) => Promise<Array<{ address: string; family: number }>>;
};

export type TransferResult = {
  bytes: number;
  contentType: string;
};

function isPrivateAddress(address: string): boolean {
  if (address.includes(":")) {
    const normalized = address.toLowerCase();
    const mappedIpv4 = normalized.match(/^::ffff:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$/);
    if (mappedIpv4) return isPrivateAddress(mappedIpv4[1]);
    if (normalized === "::" || normalized === "::1") return true;
    const firstSegment = Number.parseInt(normalized.split(":")[0] || "0", 16);
    return firstSegment === 0 ||
      (firstSegment >= 0xfc00 && firstSegment <= 0xfdff) ||
      (firstSegment >= 0xfe80 && firstSegment <= 0xfebf) ||
      firstSegment >= 0xff00;
  }

  const octets = address.split(".").map(Number);
  if (octets.length !== 4 || octets.some((octet) => !Number.isInteger(octet) || octet < 0 || octet > 255)) return true;
  return octets[0] === 0 || octets[0] === 10 || octets[0] === 127 || octets[0] >= 224 ||
    (octets[0] === 169 && octets[1] === 254) ||
    (octets[0] === 172 && octets[1] >= 16 && octets[1] <= 31) ||
    (octets[0] === 192 && octets[1] === 168);
}

async function validateMediaUrl(
  url: URL,
  allowedHosts: ReadonlySet<string>,
  resolveAddresses: NonNullable<TransferOptions["resolveAddresses"]>,
): Promise<void> {
  const hostname = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || !allowedHosts.has(hostname)) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media URL outside the approved HTTPS hosts: ${url.origin}`);
  }
  if (isIP(hostname)) {
    if (isPrivateAddress(hostname)) throw new Error(`Refusing private media IP: ${hostname}`);
    return;
  }
  const addresses = await resolveAddresses(hostname);
  if (addresses.length === 0 || addresses.some(({ address }) => isPrivateAddress(address))) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media host that resolves to a private address: ${hostname}`);
  }
}

async function requestMedia(url: URL, options: TransferOptions): Promise<Response> {
  const fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  const resolveAddresses = options.resolveAddresses ?? ((hostname) => dnsLookup(hostname, { all: true }));
  let currentUrl = url;

  for (let redirectCount = 0; redirectCount <= REDIRECT_LIMIT; redirectCount += 1) {
    await validateMediaUrl(currentUrl, options.allowedHosts, resolveAddresses);
    const signals = [AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)];
    if (options.signal) signals.push(options.signal);
    const response = await fetchImpl(currentUrl, {
      method: "GET",
      redirect: "manual",
      signal: AbortSignal.any(signals),
    });
    if (![301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(response.status)) return response;

    const location = response.headers.get("location");
    await response.body?.cancel();
    if (!location) throw new Error("Media redirect did not include a Location header");
    if (redirectCount === REDIRECT_LIMIT) throw new Error(`More than ${REDIRECT_LIMIT} media redirects`);
    currentUrl = new URL(location, currentUrl);
  }
  throw new Error("Media redirect limit exceeded");
}

async function pathExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function streamMediaToFile(
  mediaUrl: URL,
  outputPath: string,
  options: TransferOptions,
): Promise<TransferResult> {
  if (await pathExists(outputPath)) throw new Error(`File already exists: ${outputPath}`);
  const partialPath = `${outputPath}.part`;
  if (await pathExists(partialPath)) throw new Error(`Partial file already exists: ${partialPath}`);

    await mkdir(dirname(outputPath), { recursive: true });
  let response: Response | undefined;
  let partialCreated = false;
  try {
    response = await requestMedia(mediaUrl, options);
    if (response.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Media request failed with HTTP ${response.status}`);
    const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
    if (!(contentType.startsWith("audio/") || contentType === "application/octet-stream")) {
      await response.body?.cancel();
      throw new Error(`Expected audio data, received ${contentType || "unknown content type"}`);
    }
    if (contentType === "application/octet-stream" && !options.expectedFormat.trim()) {
      await response.body?.cancel();
      throw new Error("Generic binary response requires a discovered audio format");
    }
    if (!response.body) throw new Error("Media response has no body");

    const contentLengthHeader = response.headers.get("content-length");
    const expectedLength = contentLengthHeader && /^\d+$/.test(contentLengthHeader)
      ? Number(contentLengthHeader)
      : undefined;
    const source = Readable.fromWeb(response.body as import("node:stream/web").ReadableStream);
    partialCreated = true;
    await pipeline(source, createWriteStream(partialPath, { flags: "wx" }), {
      signal: options.signal,
    });
    const file = await stat(partialPath);
    if (file.size === 0) throw new Error("Media response was empty");
    if (expectedLength !== undefined && file.size !== expectedLength) {
      throw new Error(`Incomplete media response: expected ${expectedLength} bytes, received ${file.size}`);
    }

    await link(partialPath, outputPath);
    await unlink(partialPath);
    partialCreated = false;
    return { bytes: file.size, contentType };
  } catch (error) {
    await response?.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
    if (partialCreated) await rm(partialPath, { force: true });
    throw error;
  }
}

## Reliability and Safety

- Validate HTTPS album URLs on `downloads.khinsider.com`; reject unrelated input.

  in URLs, and local/private network targets. Confirm legitimate media hosts in
  the feasibility phase rather than assuming audio is on the album host.

  disc numbers without overwriting unrelated files.

  flag an existing unverified file as a conflict rather than silently trusting it.
- Retry transient network errors with bounded backoff; honor `Retry-After`.
  Stop and explain access-denied responses instead of repeatedly retrying them.
- Use timeouts, cancellation, and clear disk-full/permission-error reporting.
- Reject HTML/error responses posing as audio; check status, content type, and
  available byte-length evidence. Do not impose a minimum audio-file size.
- A rerun can restart incomplete tracks. Byte-range continuation is deferred
  until server range support and source-file identity can be verified.
- Report success only when all selected tracks are verified complete; give the
  CLI a nonzero exit status for failures and distinguish cancellation.
- Never download album audio just to run routine tests; keep live checks small.

import type { AudioLink, DiscoveredTrack } from "./khinsider.js";

const LOSSLESS_PREFERENCE = ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"];

export type FormatPolicy =
  | { kind: "prefer-lossless" }
  | { kind: "lossless-only"; skipUnavailable?: boolean }
  | { kind: "specific"; format: string; skipUnavailable?: boolean };

export type TrackFormatSelection = {
  track: DiscoveredTrack;
  selected?: AudioLink;
  fallback?: boolean;
  state: "ready" | "skipped" | "unavailable";
  reason?: string;
};

export type FormatPlan = {
  tracks: TrackFormatSelection[];
  blocked: boolean;
  incomplete: boolean;
};

function selectLossless(links: AudioLink[]): AudioLink | undefined {
  for (const format of LOSSLESS_PREFERENCE) {
    const match = links.find((link) => link.format.toUpperCase() === format);
    if (match) return match;
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function planFormats(tracks: DiscoveredTrack[], policy: FormatPolicy): FormatPlan {
  const planned = tracks.map((track): TrackFormatSelection => {
    let selected: AudioLink | undefined;
    if (policy.kind === "prefer-lossless") {
      const lossless = selectLossless(track.audioLinks);
      selected = lossless
        ?? track.audioLinks.find((link) => link.format.toUpperCase() === "MP3")
        ?? track.audioLinks[0];
      if (selected) return { track, selected, fallback: !lossless, state: "ready" };
      return { track, state: "unavailable", reason: "No audio format was discovered" };
    }

    const requested = policy.kind === "specific" ? policy.format.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    selected = requested
      ? track.audioLinks.find((link) => link.format.toUpperCase() === requested)
      : selectLossless(track.audioLinks);
    if (selected) return { track, selected, state: "ready" };

    const reason = requested ? `${requested} is unavailable` : "No lossless format is available";
    return policy.skipUnavailable
      ? { track, state: "skipped", reason }
      : { track, state: "unavailable", reason };
  });

  const unavailable = planned.some((selection) => selection.state === "unavailable");
  const skipped = planned.some((selection) => selection.state === "skipped");
  return {
    tracks: planned,
    blocked: unavailable,
    incomplete: skipped,
  };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { planFormats } from "../src/formats.js";
import type { DiscoveredTrack } from "../src/khinsider.js";

function track(number: number, formats: string[]): DiscoveredTrack {
  return {
    number,
    title: `Track ${number}`,
    pageUrl: new URL(`https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/test/${number}.mp3`),
    audioLinks: formats.map((format) => ({
      format,
      url: new URL(`https://media.example.test/${number}.${format.toLowerCase()}`),
    })),
  };
}

describe("format policy", () => {
  it("prefers lossless and marks a lossy fallback", () => {
    const plan = planFormats([track(1, ["MP3", "FLAC"]), track(2, ["MP3"]), track(3, [])], {
      kind: "prefer-lossless",
    });
    expect(plan.tracks.map(({ selected, fallback, state }) => [selected?.format, fallback, state])).toEqual([
      ["FLAC", false, "ready"],
      ["MP3", true, "ready"],
      [undefined, undefined, "unavailable"],
    ]);
    expect(plan.blocked).toBe(true);
  });

  it("blocks lossless-only runs unless missing tracks are explicitly skipped", () => {
    const tracks = [track(1, ["FLAC", "MP3"]), track(2, ["MP3"] )];
    const blocked = planFormats(tracks, { kind: "lossless-only" });
    expect(blocked.blocked).toBe(true);
    expect(blocked.incomplete).toBe(false);
    const skipped = planFormats(tracks, { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable: true });
    expect(skipped.blocked).toBe(false);
    expect(skipped.incomplete).toBe(true);
    expect(skipped.tracks[1].state).toBe("skipped");
  });

  it("never substitutes a missing explicitly selected format", () => {
    const plan = planFormats([track(1, ["MP3"])], { kind: "specific", format: "FLAC" });
    expect(plan.blocked).toBe(true);
    expect(plan.tracks[0].selected).toBeUndefined();
    expect(plan.tracks[0].reason).toBe("FLAC is unavailable");
  });
});

import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { lstat, mkdir, readFile, rename, rm, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

export const MANIFEST_FILENAME = ".download-manifest.json";

export type ManifestTrack = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  filename: string;
  format: string;
  state: "queued" | "downloading" | "complete" | "skipped" | "failed";
  bytes?: number;
  error?: string;
};

export type AlbumManifest = {
  schemaVersion: 1;
  sourceAlbum: string;
  title: string;
  state: "downloading" | "complete" | "incomplete" | "failed";
  updatedAt: string;
  tracks: ManifestTrack[];
};

export function defaultOutputRoot(): string {
  return join(homedir(), "Music", "K-Downloader");
}

export function safeFileComponent(value: string): string {
  const normalized = value
    .normalize("NFC")
    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g, "-")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/[. ]+$/g, "")
    .trim();
  return (normalized || "Untitled").slice(0, 120);
}

export function trackFilename(number: number, total: number, title: string, format: string): string {
  const width = Math.max(2, String(total).length);
  const extension = format.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
  if (!extension) throw new Error(`Invalid audio format: ${format}`);
  return `${String(number).padStart(width, "0")} - ${safeFileComponent(title)}.${extension}`;
}

function sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(new URL(sourceAlbum).pathname).digest("hex").slice(0, 8);
}

async function readSourceFromManifest(directory: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME), "utf8"));
    if (typeof parsed === "object" && parsed !== null && "sourceAlbum" in parsed && typeof parsed.sourceAlbum === "string") {
      return parsed.sourceAlbum;
    }
    return undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

export async function prepareAlbumDirectory(outputRoot: string, title: string, sourceAlbum: string): Promise<string> {
  await mkdir(outputRoot, { recursive: true });
  if (!(await stat(outputRoot)).isDirectory()) throw new Error(`Output root is not a directory: ${outputRoot}`);

  const baseDirectory = join(outputRoot, safeFileComponent(title));
  if (!(await exists(baseDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(baseDirectory);
    return baseDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(baseDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return baseDirectory;

  const identifiedDirectory = `${baseDirectory} [${sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum)}]`;
  if (!(await exists(identifiedDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(identifiedDirectory);
    return identifiedDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(identifiedDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return identifiedDirectory;
  throw new Error(`Album output folder is occupied by unrelated or unverifiable files: ${identifiedDirectory}`);
}

async function exists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function writeManifest(directory: string, manifest: AlbumManifest): Promise<void> {
  const destination = join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME);
  const temporary = join(dirname(destination), `${MANIFEST_FILENAME}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
  try {
    await writeFile(temporary, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`, { flag: "wx" });
    await rename(temporary, destination);
  } finally {
    await rm(temporary, { force: true });
  }

import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { lstat, mkdir, readFile, rename, rm, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

export const MANIFEST_FILENAME = ".download-manifest.json";

export type ManifestTrack = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  filename: string;
  format: string;
  state: "queued" | "downloading" | "complete" | "skipped" | "failed";
  bytes?: number;
  error?: string;
};

export type AlbumManifest = {
  schemaVersion: 1;
  sourceAlbum: string;
  title: string;
  state: "downloading" | "complete" | "incomplete" | "failed";
  updatedAt: string;
  tracks: ManifestTrack[];
};

export function defaultOutputRoot(): string {
  return join(homedir(), "Music", "K-Downloader");
}

export function safeFileComponent(value: string): string {
  const normalized = value
    .normalize("NFC")
    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g, "-")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/[. ]+$/g, "")
    .trim();
  return (normalized || "Untitled").slice(0, 120);
}

export function trackFilename(number: number, total: number, title: string, format: string): string {
  const width = Math.max(2, String(total).length);
  const extension = format.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
  if (!extension) throw new Error(`Invalid audio format: ${format}`);
  return `${String(number).padStart(width, "0")} - ${safeFileComponent(title)}.${extension}`;
}

function sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(new URL(sourceAlbum).pathname).digest("hex").slice(0, 8);
}

async function readSourceFromManifest(directory: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME), "utf8"));
    if (typeof parsed === "object" && parsed !== null && "sourceAlbum" in parsed && typeof parsed.sourceAlbum === "string") {
      return parsed.sourceAlbum;
    }
    return undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

export async function prepareAlbumDirectory(outputRoot: string, title: string, sourceAlbum: string): Promise<string> {
  await mkdir(outputRoot, { recursive: true });
  if (!(await stat(outputRoot)).isDirectory()) throw new Error(`Output root is not a directory: ${outputRoot}`);

  const baseDirectory = join(outputRoot, safeFileComponent(title));
  if (!(await exists(baseDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(baseDirectory);
    return baseDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(baseDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return baseDirectory;

  const identifiedDirectory = `${baseDirectory} [${sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum)}]`;
  if (!(await exists(identifiedDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(identifiedDirectory);
    return identifiedDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(identifiedDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return identifiedDirectory;
  throw new Error(`Album output folder is occupied by unrelated or unverifiable files: ${identifiedDirectory}`);
}

export async function readManifest(directory: string): Promise<AlbumManifest | undefined> {
  let raw: string;
  try {
    raw = await readFile(join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME), "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return undefined;
    throw error;
  }

  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
  if (
    typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null ||
    !("schemaVersion" in parsed) || parsed.schemaVersion !== 1 ||
    !("sourceAlbum" in parsed) || typeof parsed.sourceAlbum !== "string" ||
    !("title" in parsed) || typeof parsed.title !== "string" ||
    !("state" in parsed) || typeof parsed.state !== "string" ||
    !("tracks" in parsed) || !Array.isArray(parsed.tracks)
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid download manifest: ${join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME)}`);
  }
  return parsed as AlbumManifest;
}

async function exists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function writeManifest(directory: string, manifest: AlbumManifest): Promise<void> {
  const destination = join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME);
  const temporary = join(dirname(destination), `${MANIFEST_FILENAME}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
  try {
    await writeFile(temporary, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`, { flag: "wx" });
    await rename(temporary, destination);
  } finally {
    await rm(temporary, { force: true });
  }
}

import { createWriteStream } from "node:fs";
import { link, lstat, mkdir, rm, stat, unlink } from "node:fs/promises";
import { lookup as dnsLookup } from "node:dns/promises";
import { isIP } from "node:net";
import { dirname } from "node:path";
import { Readable } from "node:stream";
import { pipeline } from "node:stream/promises";

const REDIRECT_LIMIT = 5;
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;

export type TransferOptions = {
  allowedHosts: ReadonlySet<string>;
  expectedFormat: string;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
  resolveAddresses?: (hostname: string) => Promise<Array<{ address: string; family: number }>>;
};

export type TransferResult = {
  bytes: number;
  contentType: string;
};

export class MediaResponseError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly status: number) {
    super(`Media request failed with HTTP ${status}`);
    this.name = "MediaResponseError";
  }
}

function isPrivateAddress(address: string): boolean {
  if (address.includes(":")) {
    const normalized = address.toLowerCase();
    const mappedIpv4 = normalized.match(/^::ffff:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$/);
    if (mappedIpv4) return isPrivateAddress(mappedIpv4[1]);
    if (normalized === "::" || normalized === "::1") return true;
    const firstSegment = Number.parseInt(normalized.split(":")[0] || "0", 16);
    return firstSegment === 0 ||
      (firstSegment >= 0xfc00 && firstSegment <= 0xfdff) ||
      (firstSegment >= 0xfe80 && firstSegment <= 0xfebf) ||
      firstSegment >= 0xff00;
  }

  const octets = address.split(".").map(Number);
  if (octets.length !== 4 || octets.some((octet) => !Number.isInteger(octet) || octet < 0 || octet > 255)) return true;
  return octets[0] === 0 || octets[0] === 10 || octets[0] === 127 || octets[0] >= 224 ||
    (octets[0] === 169 && octets[1] === 254) ||
    (octets[0] === 172 && octets[1] >= 16 && octets[1] <= 31) ||
    (octets[0] === 192 && octets[1] === 168);
}

async function validateMediaUrl(
  url: URL,
  allowedHosts: ReadonlySet<string>,
  resolveAddresses: NonNullable<TransferOptions["resolveAddresses"]>,
): Promise<void> {
  const hostname = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password || !allowedHosts.has(hostname)) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media URL outside the approved HTTPS hosts: ${url.origin}`);
  }
  if (isIP(hostname)) {
    if (isPrivateAddress(hostname)) throw new Error(`Refusing private media IP: ${hostname}`);
    return;
  }
  const addresses = await resolveAddresses(hostname);
  if (addresses.length === 0 || addresses.some(({ address }) => isPrivateAddress(address))) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing media host that resolves to a private address: ${hostname}`);
  }
}

async function requestMedia(url: URL, options: TransferOptions): Promise<Response> {
  const fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  const resolveAddresses = options.resolveAddresses ?? ((hostname) => dnsLookup(hostname, { all: true }));
  let currentUrl = url;

  for (let redirectCount = 0; redirectCount <= REDIRECT_LIMIT; redirectCount += 1) {
    await validateMediaUrl(currentUrl, options.allowedHosts, resolveAddresses);
    const signals = [AbortSignal.timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)];
    if (options.signal) signals.push(options.signal);
    const response = await fetchImpl(currentUrl, {
      method: "GET",
      redirect: "manual",
      signal: AbortSignal.any(signals),
    });
    if (![301, 302, 303, 307, 308].includes(response.status)) return response;

    const location = response.headers.get("location");
    await response.body?.cancel();
    if (!location) throw new Error("Media redirect did not include a Location header");
    if (redirectCount === REDIRECT_LIMIT) throw new Error(`More than ${REDIRECT_LIMIT} media redirects`);
    currentUrl = new URL(location, currentUrl);
  }
  throw new Error("Media redirect limit exceeded");
}

async function pathExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function streamMediaToFile(
  mediaUrl: URL,
  outputPath: string,
  options: TransferOptions,
): Promise<TransferResult> {
  if (await pathExists(outputPath)) throw new Error(`File already exists: ${outputPath}`);
  const partialPath = `${outputPath}.part`;
  if (await pathExists(partialPath)) throw new Error(`Partial file already exists: ${partialPath}`);

    await mkdir(dirname(outputPath), { recursive: true });
  let response: Response | undefined;
  let partialCreated = false;
  try {
    response = await requestMedia(mediaUrl, options);
    if (response.status !== 200) throw new MediaResponseError(response.status);
    const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
    if (!(contentType.startsWith("audio/") || contentType === "application/octet-stream")) {
      await response.body?.cancel();
      throw new Error(`Expected audio data, received ${contentType || "unknown content type"}`);
    }
    if (contentType === "application/octet-stream" && !options.expectedFormat.trim()) {
      await response.body?.cancel();
      throw new Error("Generic binary response requires a discovered audio format");
    }
    const expectedTypes: Record<string, string[]> = {
      MP3: ["audio/mpeg", "audio/mp3"],
      FLAC: ["audio/flac", "audio/x-flac"],
      OGG: ["audio/ogg", "application/ogg"],
      OPUS: ["audio/ogg", "audio/opus"],
      WAV: ["audio/wav", "audio/x-wav", "audio/wave"],
      M4A: ["audio/mp4", "audio/x-m4a"],
      AAC: ["audio/aac", "audio/x-aac"],
      WMA: ["audio/x-ms-wma", "audio/wma"],
      ALAC: ["audio/mp4", "audio/x-m4a"],
    };
    const acceptedTypes = expectedTypes[options.expectedFormat.toUpperCase()];
    if (contentType !== "application/octet-stream" && acceptedTypes && !acceptedTypes.includes(contentType)) {
      await response.body?.cancel();
      throw new Error(`Expected ${options.expectedFormat} audio, received ${contentType}`);
    }
    if (!response.body) throw new Error("Media response has no body");

    const contentLengthHeader = response.headers.get("content-length");
    const expectedLength = contentLengthHeader && /^\d+$/.test(contentLengthHeader)
      ? Number(contentLengthHeader)
      : undefined;
    const source = Readable.fromWeb(response.body as import("node:stream/web").ReadableStream);
    partialCreated = true;
    await pipeline(source, createWriteStream(partialPath, { flags: "wx" }), {
      signal: options.signal,
    });
    const file = await stat(partialPath);
    if (file.size === 0) throw new Error("Media response was empty");
    if (expectedLength !== undefined && file.size !== expectedLength) {
      throw new Error(`Incomplete media response: expected ${expectedLength} bytes, received ${file.size}`);
    }

    await link(partialPath, outputPath);
    await unlink(partialPath);
    partialCreated = false;
    return { bytes: file.size, contentType };
  } catch (error) {
    await response?.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
    if (partialCreated) await rm(partialPath, { force: true });
    throw error;
  }
}
```

import { link as hardLink, lstat, rm, stat, unlink } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { planFormats, type FormatPolicy } from "./formats.js";
import type { AlbumPage, DiscoveredTrack } from "./khinsider.js";
import {
  prepareAlbumDirectory,
  readManifest,
  trackFilename,
  writeManifest,
  type AlbumManifest,
  type ManifestTrack,
} from "./output.js";
import { MediaResponseError, streamMediaToFile, type TransferOptions, type TransferResult } from "./transfer.js";

export type DownloadOptions = {
  sourceAlbum: string;
  album: AlbumPage;
  tracks: DiscoveredTrack[];
  outputRoot: string;
  policy: FormatPolicy;
  fetchImpl?: TransferOptions["fetchImpl"];
  resolveAddresses?: TransferOptions["resolveAddresses"];
};

export type DownloadResult = {
  directory: string;
  state: AlbumManifest["state"];
  tracks: ManifestTrack[];
};

export class FormatPlanBlockedError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly tracks: string[]) {
    super(`Download blocked; resolve unavailable formats first: ${tracks.join(", ")}`);
    this.name = "FormatPlanBlockedError";
  }
}

async function fileExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function isVerifiedComplete(directory: string, entry: ManifestTrack | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!entry || entry.state !== "complete" || !entry.bytes || !entry.filename) return false;
  try {
    const file = await stat(join(directory, entry.filename));
    return file.isFile() && file.size === entry.bytes;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

function createManifestTrack(
  number: number,
  title: string,
  filename: string,
  format: string,
  state: ManifestTrack["state"],
): ManifestTrack {
  return { number, title, filename, format, state };
}

export async function downloadAlbum(options: DownloadOptions): Promise<DownloadResult> {
  const plan = planFormats(options.tracks, options.policy);
  const blockedTracks = plan.tracks
    .filter((selection) => selection.state === "unavailable")
    .map(({ track, reason }) => `${track.number}. ${track.title}: ${reason}`);
  if (blockedTracks.length > 0) throw new FormatPlanBlockedError(blockedTracks);

  const directory = await prepareAlbumDirectory(options.outputRoot, options.album.title, options.sourceAlbum);
  const previous = await readManifest(directory);
  if (previous && previous.sourceAlbum !== options.sourceAlbum) {
    throw new Error(`Manifest source does not match album URL: ${directory}`);
  }

  const manifestTracks: ManifestTrack[] = [];
  for (const selection of plan.tracks) {
    const { track, selected, state } = selection;
    if (!selected || state === "skipped") {
      manifestTracks.push(createManifestTrack(track.number, track.title, "", "", "skipped"));
      continue;
    }

    const filename = trackFilename(track.number, plan.tracks.length, track.title, selected.format);
    const current = previous?.tracks.find((entry) => entry.filename === filename && entry.format === selected.format);
    const target = join(directory, filename);
    const partial = `${target}.part`;
    const targetExists = await fileExists(target);
    if (targetExists && !(await isVerifiedComplete(directory, current))) {
      throw new Error(`Existing file is not verified by the manifest: ${target}`);
    }
    if (await fileExists(partial)) {
      if (current?.state === "downloading" || current?.state === "failed") await rm(partial);
      else throw new Error(`Unverified partial file already exists: ${partial}`);
    }
    manifestTracks.push({
      ...createManifestTrack(track.number, track.title, filename, selected.format, targetExists ? "complete" : "queued"),
      ...(targetExists ? { bytes: current?.bytes } : {}),
    });
  }

  const manifest: AlbumManifest = {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceAlbum: options.sourceAlbum,
    title: options.album.title,
    state: "downloading",
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    tracks: manifestTracks,
  };
  await writeManifest(directory, manifest);

  for (const [index, selection] of plan.tracks.entries()) {
    const entry = manifest.tracks[index];
    if (entry.state === "complete" || entry.state === "skipped") continue;
    const audio = selection.selected;
    if (!audio) continue;

    entry.state = "downloading";
    manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
    try {
      const transferOptions: TransferOptions = {
        allowedHosts: new Set([audio.url.hostname.toLowerCase()]),
        expectedFormat: audio.format,
        ...(options.fetchImpl ? { fetchImpl: options.fetchImpl } : {}),
        ...(options.resolveAddresses ? { resolveAddresses: options.resolveAddresses } : {}),
      };
      const result: TransferResult = await streamMediaToFile(audio.url, join(directory, entry.filename), transferOptions);
      entry.state = "complete";
      entry.bytes = result.bytes;
      delete entry.error;
    } catch (error) {
      entry.state = "failed";
      entry.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0, 500) : String(error).slice(0, 500);
      manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
      if (error instanceof MediaResponseError && [403, 429].includes(error.status)) break;
      continue;
    }
    manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
  }

  const hasFailures = manifest.tracks.some((track) => track.state === "failed");
  const hasSkips = manifest.tracks.some((track) => track.state === "skipped");
  manifest.state = hasFailures ? "failed" : hasSkips ? "incomplete" : "complete";
  manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
  return { directory, state: manifest.state, tracks: manifest.tracks };
}

import { mkdtemp, readFile, readdir, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { downloadAlbum, FormatPlanBlockedError } from "../src/downloader.js";
import type { AlbumPage, DiscoveredTrack } from "../src/khinsider.js";

const sourceAlbum = "https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/fixture-album";
const audioHost = "lambda.vgmtreasurechest.com";
const resolveAddresses = async () => [{ address: "93.184.216.34", family: 4 }];
const temporaryDirectories: string[] = [];

const album: AlbumPage = {
  title: "Fixture Album",
  advertisedTrackCount: 2,
  tracks: [],
};

function tracks(formats: string[][] = [["MP3"], ["MP3"]]): DiscoveredTrack[] {
  return formats.map((available, index) => ({
    number: index + 1,
    title: index === 0 ? "Opening" : "Finale",
    pageUrl: new URL(`${sourceAlbum}/${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}.mp3`),
    audioLinks: available.map((format) => ({
      format,
      url: new URL(`https://${audioHost}/${index + 1}.${format.toLowerCase()}`),
    })),
  }));
}

async function temporaryDirectory(): Promise<string> {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "k-downloader-album-test-"));
  temporaryDirectories.push(directory);
  return directory;
}

afterEach(async () => {
  await Promise.all(temporaryDirectories.splice(0).map((directory) => rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })));
});

describe("single-album download", () => {
  it("streams selected tracks and skips size-verified files on rerun", async () => {
    const outputRoot = await temporaryDirectory();
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async () => new Response(new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { "content-type": "audio/mpeg", "content-length": "3" },
    }));
    const options = {
      sourceAlbum,
      album,
      tracks: tracks(),
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "prefer-lossless" as const },
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    };

    const first = await downloadAlbum(options);
    expect(first.state).toBe("complete");
    expect(first.tracks.map(({ state }) => state)).toEqual(["complete", "complete"]);
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(await readdir(first.directory)).toEqual([
      ".download-manifest.json",
      "01 - Opening.mp3",
      "02 - Finale.mp3",
    ]);

    const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(first.directory, ".download-manifest.json"), "utf8"));
    expect(manifest.state).toBe("complete");
    expect(manifest.tracks.map((track: { bytes: number }) => track.bytes)).toEqual([3, 3]);

    const rerunFetch = vi.fn();
    const second = await downloadAlbum({ ...options, fetchImpl: rerunFetch });
    expect(second.directory).toBe(first.directory);
    expect(second.state).toBe("complete");
    expect(rerunFetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("blocks unavailable lossless tracks before creating output or transferring", async () => {
    const outputRoot = join(await temporaryDirectory(), "not-created");
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn();
    await expect(downloadAlbum({
      sourceAlbum,
      album,
      tracks: tracks([["FLAC"], ["MP3"]]),
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "lossless-only" },
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(FormatPlanBlockedError);
    expect(fetchImpl).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await expect(readdir(outputRoot)).rejects.toThrow();
  });

  it("stops the album on site-wide 403 and leaves later tracks queued", async () => {
    const outputRoot = await temporaryDirectory();
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async () => new Response("denied", { status: 403 }));
    const result = await downloadAlbum({
      sourceAlbum,
      album,
      tracks: tracks(),
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "prefer-lossless" },
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    });
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(result.state).toBe("failed");
    expect(result.tracks.map(({ state }) => state)).toEqual(["failed", "queued"]);
  });
});
```

````
# K-Downloader

K-Downloader is a Linux-first KHInsider album downloader. The first implemented
slice is public album and track-link discovery; audio transfer, queue recovery,
GUI, optional account features, and packaging are not implemented yet.

## Discovery check

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer, npm, and a graphical desktop session.

```sh
npm install
npx playwright install chromium
npm run inspect -- 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack'
```

The command opens a fresh visible Chromium context without a stored browser
profile, visits the album and its first track page, and prints the discovered
track count and audio link. It does not sign in or download audio. This visible
mode is currently needed: plain Node fetch and headless Chromium received HTTP
403 during feasibility checks, while a fresh visible Chromium context succeeded.
No attempt is made to imitate a browser or evade a challenge. If access is denied
or a challenge appears, stop and review the site's permitted access methods.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run build
```
````

  console.error("Usage:\n  npm run inspect -- <album-url>\n  npm run download -- <album-url> [--format prefer-lossless|lossless-only|FORMAT] [--skip-unavailable] [--output DIR]");
  process.exit(2);
}

function printPlan(
  album: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof inspectAlbum>>["album"],
  tracks: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof inspectAlbum>>["tracks"],
  policy: FormatPolicy,
): boolean {
  const plan = planFormats(tracks, policy);
  console.log(`Album: ${album.title}`);
  console.log(`Tracks: ${album.tracks.length}${album.advertisedTrackCount ? ` / ${album.advertisedTrackCount}` : ""}`);
  for (const selection of plan.tracks) {
    const { track, selected, state, reason, fallback } = selection;
    const prefix = `${String(track.number).padStart(2, "0")} - ${track.title}`;
    if (selected) console.log(`${prefix}: ${selected.format}${fallback ? " (lossy fallback)" : ""}`);
    else console.log(`${prefix}: ${state}${reason ? ` (${reason})` : ""}`);
  }
  return !plan.blocked;
}

async function inspectCommand(albumUrl: string, args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (args.length > 0) usage();
  const { album, tracks } = await inspectAlbum(albumUrl);
  if (printPlan(album, tracks, { kind: "prefer-lossless" })) {
    console.log("Format preview complete; no audio was downloaded.");
  } else process.exitCode = 1;
}

async function downloadCommand(albumUrl: string, args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  let format = "prefer-lossless";
  let outputRoot = defaultOutputRoot();
  let skipUnavailable = false;
  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
    const arg = args[index];
    if (arg === "--skip-unavailable") skipUnavailable = true;
    else if (arg === "--format" || arg === "--output") {
      const value = args[index + 1];
      if (!value) usage();
      index += 1;
      if (arg === "--format") format = value;
      else outputRoot = value;
    } else usage();
  }
  if (skipUnavailable && format.toLowerCase() === "prefer-lossless") {
    throw new Error("--skip-unavailable is only valid with lossless-only or a specific --format");
  }

  const policy: FormatPolicy = format.toLowerCase() === "prefer-lossless"
    ? { kind: "prefer-lossless" }
    : format.toLowerCase() === "lossless-only"
      ? { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable }
      : { kind: "specific", format, skipUnavailable };
  const sourceAlbum = new URL(albumUrl).href;
  const { album, tracks } = await inspectAlbum(sourceAlbum);
  if (!printPlan(album, tracks, policy)) {
    console.error("No audio was downloaded. Resolve unavailable formats or explicitly pass --skip-unavailable.");
    process.exitCode = 1;
    return;
  }

  console.log(`\nDestination: ${outputRoot}`);
  console.log("Starting sequential transfers...");
  const result = await downloadAlbum({ sourceAlbum, album, tracks, outputRoot: resolve(outputRoot), policy });
  console.log(`\nAlbum result: ${result.state}`);
  console.log(`Folder: ${result.directory}`);
  if (result.state !== "complete") process.exitCode = 1;
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const [command, albumUrl, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (!albumUrl) usage();
  if (command === "inspect") await inspectCommand(albumUrl, args);
  else if (command === "download") await downloadCommand(albumUrl, args);
  else usage();
}

main().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.error(`K-Downloader failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

````
# K-Downloader

K-Downloader is a Linux-first KHInsider album downloader. The current slice
implements public single-album discovery, format preview and policy, sequential
streaming, and manifest-backed reruns. Multi-album queues, artwork, the GUI,
optional account features, and packaging are not implemented yet.

## Discovery check

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer, npm, and a graphical desktop session.

```sh
npm install
npx playwright install chromium
npm run inspect -- 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack'
```

The command opens a fresh visible Chromium context without a stored browser
profile, visits the album and track pages sequentially, and prints every
track's discovered format selection. It does not sign in or download audio.
Visible mode is currently needed: plain Node fetch and headless Chromium
received HTTP 403 during feasibility checks, while a fresh visible Chromium
context succeeded. No attempt is made to imitate a browser or evade a challenge.
If access is denied or a challenge appears, stop and review the site's permitted
access methods.

## Download One Album

The CLI previews the selected formats before starting any transfer. The default
format policy prefers lossless, falling back to MP3 when needed. The default
destination is `~/Music/K-Downloader`.

```sh
npm run download -- 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack'
```

Use `--format lossless-only` to block when a track has no lossless source. Add
`--skip-unavailable` to explicitly skip those tracks and mark the album
incomplete. A specific format such as `--format MP3` never silently substitutes
another format. Use `--output /path/to/music` for another destination.

Files are streamed through temporary `.part` files, validated, and moved into
place without overwriting. A per-album manifest records completion so verified
files can be skipped on rerun. Transfers are covered by local mocked tests; an
authorized live audio download has not yet been run.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run build
npm audit
```
````

async function isVerifiedComplete(directory: string, entry: ManifestTrack | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!entry || entry.state !== "complete" || !entry.bytes || !entry.filename) return false;
  try {
    const file = await stat(join(directory, entry.filename));
    return file.isFile() && file.size === entry.bytes;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export type ManifestTrack = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  filename: string;

export function defaultOutputRoot(): string {
  return join(homedir(), "Music", "K-Downloader");

export function safeFileComponent(value: string): string {
  const normalized = value
    .normalize("NFC")
    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g, "-")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/[. ]+$/g, "")
    .trim();
  return (normalized || "Untitled").slice(0, 120);
}

export function trackFilename(number: number, total: number, title: string, format: string): string {
  const width = Math.max(2, String(total).length);

  if (!extension) throw new Error(`Invalid audio format: ${format}`);
  return `${String(number).padStart(width, "0")} - ${safeFileComponent(title)}.${extension}`;
}

import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { lstat, mkdir, readFile, rename, rm, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

export const MANIFEST_FILENAME = ".download-manifest.json";

export type ManifestTrack = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  filename: string;
  format: string;
  state: "queued" | "downloading" | "complete" | "skipped" | "failed" | "canceled";
  bytes?: number;
  error?: string;
};

export type AlbumManifest = {
  schemaVersion: 1;
  sourceAlbum: string;
  title: string;
  state: "downloading" | "complete" | "incomplete" | "failed" | "canceled";
  updatedAt: string;
  tracks: ManifestTrack[];
};

export function defaultOutputRoot(): string {
  return join(homedir(), "Music", "K-Downloader");
}

export function safeFileComponent(value: string): string {
  const normalized = value
    .normalize("NFC")
    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g, "-")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/[. ]+$/g, "")
    .trim();
  return (normalized || "Untitled").slice(0, 120);
}

export function trackFilename(number: number, total: number, title: string, format: string): string {
  const width = Math.max(2, String(total).length);
  const extension = format.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
  if (!extension) throw new Error(`Invalid audio format: ${format}`);
  return `${String(number).padStart(width, "0")} - ${safeFileComponent(title)}.${extension}`;
}

function sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(new URL(sourceAlbum).pathname).digest("hex").slice(0, 8);
}

async function readSourceFromManifest(directory: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME), "utf8"));
    if (typeof parsed === "object" && parsed !== null && "sourceAlbum" in parsed && typeof parsed.sourceAlbum === "string") {
      return parsed.sourceAlbum;
    }
    return undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

export async function prepareAlbumDirectory(outputRoot: string, title: string, sourceAlbum: string): Promise<string> {
  await mkdir(outputRoot, { recursive: true });
  if (!(await stat(outputRoot)).isDirectory()) throw new Error(`Output root is not a directory: ${outputRoot}`);

  const baseDirectory = join(outputRoot, safeFileComponent(title));
  if (!(await exists(baseDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(baseDirectory);
    return baseDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(baseDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return baseDirectory;

  const identifiedDirectory = `${baseDirectory} [${sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum)}]`;
  if (!(await exists(identifiedDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(identifiedDirectory);
    return identifiedDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(identifiedDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return identifiedDirectory;
  throw new Error(`Album output folder is occupied by unrelated or unverifiable files: ${identifiedDirectory}`);
}

export async function readManifest(directory: string): Promise<AlbumManifest | undefined> {
  let raw: string;
  try {
    raw = await readFile(join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME), "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return undefined;
    throw error;
  }

  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
  if (
    typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null ||
    !("schemaVersion" in parsed) || parsed.schemaVersion !== 1 ||
    !("sourceAlbum" in parsed) || typeof parsed.sourceAlbum !== "string" ||
    !("title" in parsed) || typeof parsed.title !== "string" ||
    !("state" in parsed) || typeof parsed.state !== "string" ||
    !("tracks" in parsed) || !Array.isArray(parsed.tracks)
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid download manifest: ${join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME)}`);
  }
  return parsed as AlbumManifest;
}

async function exists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function writeManifest(directory: string, manifest: AlbumManifest): Promise<void> {
  const destination = join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME);
  const temporary = join(dirname(destination), `${MANIFEST_FILENAME}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
  try {
    await writeFile(temporary, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`, { flag: "wx" });
    await rename(temporary, destination);
  } finally {
    await rm(temporary, { force: true });
  }
}

import { lstat, rm, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { planFormats, type FormatPolicy } from "./formats.js";
import type { AlbumPage, DiscoveredTrack } from "./khinsider.js";
import {
  prepareAlbumDirectory,
  readManifest,
  trackFilename,
  writeManifest,
  type AlbumManifest,
  type ManifestTrack,
} from "./output.js";
import { MediaResponseError, streamMediaToFile, type TransferOptions, type TransferResult } from "./transfer.js";

export type DownloadOptions = {
  sourceAlbum: string;
  album: AlbumPage;
  tracks: DiscoveredTrack[];
  outputRoot: string;
  policy: FormatPolicy;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  onProgress?: (progress: DownloadProgress) => void;
  fetchImpl?: TransferOptions["fetchImpl"];
  resolveAddresses?: TransferOptions["resolveAddresses"];
};

export type DownloadProgress = {
  stage: "track-start" | "track-complete" | "track-failed" | "canceled";
  number: number;
  title: string;
  completedTracks: number;
  totalTracks: number;
  bytesReceived?: number;
};

export type DownloadResult = {
  directory: string;
  state: AlbumManifest["state"];
  tracks: ManifestTrack[];
};

export class FormatPlanBlockedError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly tracks: string[]) {
    super(`Download blocked; resolve unavailable formats first: ${tracks.join(", ")}`);
    this.name = "FormatPlanBlockedError";
  }
}

async function fileExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function isVerifiedComplete(directory: string, entry: ManifestTrack | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!entry || entry.state !== "complete" || !entry.bytes || !entry.filename) return false;
  try {
    const file = await stat(join(directory, entry.filename));
    return file.isFile() && file.size === entry.bytes;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

function createManifestTrack(
  number: number,
  title: string,
  filename: string,
  format: string,
  state: ManifestTrack["state"],
): ManifestTrack {
  return { number, title, filename, format, state };
}

export async function downloadAlbum(options: DownloadOptions): Promise<DownloadResult> {
  const plan = planFormats(options.tracks, options.policy);
  const blockedTracks = plan.tracks
    .filter((selection) => selection.state === "unavailable")
    .map(({ track, reason }) => `${track.number}. ${track.title}: ${reason}`);
  if (blockedTracks.length > 0) throw new FormatPlanBlockedError(blockedTracks);

  const directory = await prepareAlbumDirectory(options.outputRoot, options.album.title, options.sourceAlbum);
  const previous = await readManifest(directory);
  if (previous && previous.sourceAlbum !== options.sourceAlbum) {
    throw new Error(`Manifest source does not match album URL: ${directory}`);
  }

  const manifestTracks: ManifestTrack[] = [];
  for (const selection of plan.tracks) {
    const { track, selected, state } = selection;
    if (!selected || state === "skipped") {
      manifestTracks.push(createManifestTrack(track.number, track.title, "", "", "skipped"));
      continue;
    }

    const filename = trackFilename(track.number, plan.tracks.length, track.title, selected.format);
    const current = previous?.tracks.find((entry) => entry.filename === filename && entry.format === selected.format);
    const target = join(directory, filename);
    const partial = `${target}.part`;
    const targetExists = await fileExists(target);
    if (targetExists && !(await isVerifiedComplete(directory, current))) {
      throw new Error(`Existing file is not verified by the manifest: ${target}`);
    }
    if (await fileExists(partial)) {
      if (current?.state === "downloading" || current?.state === "failed") await rm(partial);
      else throw new Error(`Unverified partial file already exists: ${partial}`);
    }
    manifestTracks.push({
      ...createManifestTrack(track.number, track.title, filename, selected.format, targetExists ? "complete" : "queued"),
      ...(targetExists ? { bytes: current?.bytes } : {}),
    });
  }

  const manifest: AlbumManifest = {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceAlbum: options.sourceAlbum,
    title: options.album.title,
    state: "downloading",
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    tracks: manifestTracks,
  };
  await writeManifest(directory, manifest);

  let completedTracks = manifest.tracks.filter((track) => track.state === "complete" || track.state === "skipped").length;
  let canceled = false;
  for (const [index, selection] of plan.tracks.entries()) {
    const entry = manifest.tracks[index];
    if (entry.state === "complete" || entry.state === "skipped") continue;
    const audio = selection.selected;
    if (!audio) continue;

    if (options.signal?.aborted) {
      entry.state = "canceled";
      for (const queued of manifest.tracks.slice(index + 1)) {
        if (queued.state === "queued") queued.state = "canceled";
      }
      canceled = true;
      options.onProgress?.({ stage: "canceled", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
      break;
    }

    entry.state = "downloading";
    options.onProgress?.({ stage: "track-start", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
    manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
    try {
      const transferOptions: TransferOptions = {
        allowedHosts: new Set([audio.url.hostname.toLowerCase()]),
        expectedFormat: audio.format,
        ...(options.signal ? { signal: options.signal } : {}),
        ...(options.fetchImpl ? { fetchImpl: options.fetchImpl } : {}),
        ...(options.resolveAddresses ? { resolveAddresses: options.resolveAddresses } : {}),
      };
      const result: TransferResult = await streamMediaToFile(audio.url, join(directory, entry.filename), transferOptions);
      entry.state = "complete";
      entry.bytes = result.bytes;
      delete entry.error;
      completedTracks += 1;
      options.onProgress?.({ stage: "track-complete", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length, bytesReceived: result.bytes });
    } catch (error) {
      if (options.signal?.aborted) {
        entry.state = "canceled";
        for (const queued of manifest.tracks.slice(index + 1)) {
          if (queued.state === "queued") queued.state = "canceled";
        }
        canceled = true;
        options.onProgress?.({ stage: "canceled", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
        manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
        break;
      }
      entry.state = "failed";
      entry.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0, 500) : String(error).slice(0, 500);
      options.onProgress?.({ stage: "track-failed", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
      manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
      if (error instanceof MediaResponseError && [403, 429].includes(error.status)) break;
      continue;
    }
    manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
  }

  const hasFailures = manifest.tracks.some((track) => track.state === "failed");
  const hasSkips = manifest.tracks.some((track) => track.state === "skipped");
  manifest.state = canceled ? "canceled" : hasFailures ? "failed" : hasSkips ? "incomplete" : "complete";
  manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
  return { directory, state: manifest.state, tracks: manifest.tracks };
}
